mayek_text: ꯑ ꯒ B ꯒꯅ ꯊꯕꯛ ꯑꯃ ꯅꯨꯃꯤ 6 ꯅꯤꯗ ꯇꯧꯕ ꯉꯝꯃꯤ꯫ ꯀꯔꯤꯒꯨꯝꯕ ꯑ ꯃꯊꯟꯇꯅ ꯊꯕꯛꯇꯨ ꯅꯨꯃꯤꯠ 18 ꯅꯤꯗ ꯇꯧꯕ ꯉꯝꯂꯕꯗꯤ, B ꯅ ꯊꯕꯛꯇꯨ ꯂꯣꯏꯁꯤꯟꯕꯗ ꯆꯪꯒꯗꯕ ꯅꯨꯃꯤꯠ ꯃꯁꯤꯡ ꯑꯗꯨ:

mayek_text: ꯑ ꯒ B ꯒꯅ ꯊꯕꯛ ꯑꯃ ꯅꯨꯃꯤꯠ 30 ꯅꯤꯗ, B ꯒ C ꯒꯅ ꯅꯨꯃꯤꯠ 20 ꯅꯤꯗ ꯑꯗꯨꯒ C ꯒ ꯑ ꯒꯅ ꯅꯨꯃꯤꯠ 15 ꯅꯤꯗ ꯇꯧꯕ ꯉꯝꯃꯤ꯫ ꯃꯈꯣꯏ ꯄꯨꯟꯅ ꯁꯨꯃꯤꯟꯅꯔꯕꯗꯤ, ꯊꯕꯛꯇꯨ ꯂꯣꯏꯁꯤꯟꯕꯗ ꯆꯪꯒꯗꯕ ꯃꯇꯝꯗꯨ:

english_text: 17. A alone can complete a work in 12 days. A and B together can complete it in 8 days. How long will B alone take to complete the work?
bmei_text: A mYNtn YbK Am numiT 12 nid tOb zMmi| A g B gn Ybktubu numiT 8 nid tOb zMmi| B mYNtn YbKtu loIsiNbd kayaM kuIn cxgni?
mayek_text: ꯑ ꯃꯊꯟꯇꯅ ꯊꯕꯛ ꯑꯃ ꯅꯨꯃꯤꯠ 12 ꯅꯤꯗ ꯇꯧꯕ ꯉꯝꯃꯤ꯫ ꯑ ꯒ B ꯒꯅ ꯊꯕꯀꯇꯨꯕꯨ ꯅꯨꯃꯤꯠ 8 ꯅꯤꯗ ꯇꯧꯕ ꯉꯝꯃꯤ꯫ B ꯃꯊꯟꯇꯅ ꯊꯕꯛꯇꯨ ꯂꯣꯏꯁꯤꯟꯕꯗ ꯀꯥꯌꯥꯝ ꯀꯨꯏꯅ ꯆꯪꯒꯅꯤ?

english_text: 18. A and B can do a work in 12 days, B and C in 15 days and C and A in 20 days. If A, B and C work together, they will complete the work in:
bmei_text: A g B gn YbK Am numiT 12 nid, B g C gn numiT 15 nid Adug C g A gn numiT 20 nid tOb zMmi| kriguMb A, B AmsuZ C n puNn tOmiNnrbdi, mHoIn YbKtu numiT kayanid tOb zMgni?
mayek_text: ꯑ ꯒ B ꯒꯅ ꯊꯕꯛ ꯑꯃ ꯅꯨꯃꯤꯠ 12 ꯅꯤꯗ, B ꯒ C ꯒꯅ ꯅꯨꯃꯤꯠ 15 ꯅꯤꯗ ꯑꯗꯨꯒ C ꯒ ꯑ ꯒꯅ ꯅꯨꯃꯤꯠ 20 ꯅꯤꯗ ꯇꯧꯕ ꯉꯝꯃꯤ꯫ ꯀꯔꯤꯒꯨꯝꯕ ꯑ, B ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ C ꯅ ꯄꯨꯟꯅ ꯇꯧꯃꯤꯟꯅꯔꯕꯗꯤ, ꯃꯈꯣꯏꯅ ꯊꯕꯛꯇꯨ ꯅꯨꯃꯤꯠ ꯀꯥꯌꯥꯅꯤꯗ ꯇꯧꯕ ꯉꯝꯒꯅꯤ?

english_text: 19. A and B can do a piece of work in 72 days. B and C can do it in 120 days, A and C can do it in 90 days. In how many days all the three together can do the work?
bmei_text: A AmsuZ B n YbK Am numiT 72 nid tOb zMmi| B g C gn numiT 120 nid Ag C gn numiT 90 nid tOb zMmi| numiT kayanid mHoI AhuMn puNn YbKtubu tOb zMgni?
mayek_text: ꯑ ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ B ꯅ ꯊꯕꯛ ꯑꯃ ꯅꯨꯃꯤꯠ 72 ꯅꯤꯗ ꯇꯧꯕ ꯉꯝꯃꯤ꯫ B ꯒ C ꯒꯅ ꯅꯨꯃꯤꯠ 120 ꯅꯤꯗ ꯑꯒ C ꯒꯅ ꯅꯨꯃꯤꯠ 90 ꯅꯤꯗ ꯇꯧꯕ ꯉꯝꯃꯤ꯫ ꯅꯨꯃꯤꯠ ꯀꯥꯌꯥꯅꯤꯗ ꯃꯈꯣꯏ ꯑꯍꯨꯝꯅ ꯄꯨꯟꯅ ꯊꯕꯛꯇꯨꯕꯨ ꯇꯧꯕ ꯉꯝꯒꯅꯤ?

english_text: 20. A particular job can be completed by a team of 10 men in 12 days. The same job can be completed by a team of 10 women in 6 days. How many days are needed to complete the job if the two teams work together?
bmei_text: AHNnb YbK Am nupa 10 gi ApuNb Amn numiT 12 nid loIsiNb zMmi| YbK AdumK nupi 10 gi ApuNb Amn numiT 6 nid loIsiNb zMmi| ApuNb Anidudu puNn sumiNnrbdi, YbKtu loIsiNbd numiT kayani cxgni?
mayek_text: ꯑꯈꯟꯅꯕ ꯊꯕꯛ ꯑꯃ ꯅꯨꯄꯥ 10 ꯒꯤ ꯑꯄꯨꯟꯕ ꯑꯃꯅ ꯅꯨꯃꯤꯠ 12 ꯅꯤꯗ ꯂꯣꯏꯁꯤꯟꯕ ꯉꯝꯃꯤ꯫ ꯊꯕꯛ ꯑꯗꯨꯃꯛ ꯅꯨꯄꯤ 10 ꯒꯤ ꯑꯄꯨꯟꯕ ꯑꯃꯅ ꯅꯨꯃꯤꯠ 6 ꯅꯤꯗ ꯂꯣꯏꯁꯤꯟꯕ ꯉꯝꯃꯤ꯫ ꯑꯄꯨꯟꯕ ꯑꯅꯤꯗꯨꯗꯨ ꯄꯨꯟꯅ ꯁꯨꯃꯤꯟꯅꯔꯕꯗꯤ, ꯊꯕꯛꯇꯨ ꯂꯣꯏꯁꯤꯟꯕꯗ ꯅꯨꯃꯤꯠ ꯀꯥꯌꯥꯅꯤ ꯆꯪꯒꯅꯤ?

english_text: 21. A and B can do a piece of work in 10 days, B and C in 15 days and C and A in 20 days. C alone can do the work in:
bmei_text: A g B gn YbK Am numiT 10 nid tOb zMmi, B g C gn numiT 15 nid Adug C g A gn numiT 20 nid zMmi| C mYNtn YbKtu numiT kayanid tOb zMgni?
mayek_text: ꯑ ꯒ B ꯒꯅ ꯊꯕꯛ ꯑꯃ ꯅꯨꯃꯤꯠ 10 ꯅꯤꯗ ꯇꯧꯕ ꯉꯝꯃꯤ, B ꯒ C ꯒꯅ ꯅꯨꯃꯤꯠ 15 ꯅꯤꯗ ꯑꯗꯨꯒ C ꯒ ꯑ ꯒꯅ ꯅꯨꯃꯤꯠ 20 ꯅꯤꯗ ꯉꯝꯃꯤ꯫ C ꯃꯊꯟꯇꯅ ꯊꯕꯛꯇꯨ ꯅꯨꯃꯤꯠ ꯀꯥꯌꯥꯅꯤꯗ ꯇꯧꯕ ꯉꯝꯒꯅꯤ?

english_text: 22. A can do a piece of work in 4 hours; B and C can do it in 3 hours. A and C can do it in 2 hours. How long will B alone take to do it?
bmei_text: A n YbK puZ 4 gi mnuZd, B g C gn puZ 3 gi mnuZd tOb zMmi| A g C gn puZ 2 gi mnuZd tOb zMmi| B mYNtn YbKtu tObd kayaM kuIn cxgni?
mayek_text: ꯑ ꯅ ꯊꯕꯛ ꯄꯨꯡ 4 ꯒꯤ ꯃꯅꯨꯡꯗ, B ꯒ C ꯒꯅ ꯄꯨꯡ 3 ꯒꯤ ꯃꯅꯨꯡꯗ ꯇꯧꯕ ꯉꯝꯃꯤ꯫ ꯑ ꯒ C ꯒꯅ ꯄꯨꯡ 2 ꯒꯤ ꯃꯅꯨꯡꯗ ꯇꯧꯕ ꯉꯝꯃꯤ꯫ B ꯃꯊꯟꯇꯅ ꯊꯕꯛꯇꯨ ꯇꯧꯕꯗ ꯀꯥꯌꯥꯝ ꯀꯨꯏꯅ ꯆꯪꯒꯅꯤ?

english_text: 23. A, B and C can complete a piece of work in 24, 6 and 12 days respectively. Working together, they will complete the same work in:
bmei_text: A, b AmsuZ C n YbK Am mYx-siTn numiT 24, 6 Amdi 12 nid loIsiNb zMmi| puNn sumiNndun, mHoIn YbKtumK numiT kayanid loIsiNb zMgni?
mayek_text: ꯑ, ꯕ ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ C ꯅ ꯊꯕꯛ ꯑꯃ ꯃꯊꯪ-ꯁꯤꯠꯅ ꯅꯨꯃꯤꯠ 24, 6 ꯑꯃꯗꯤ 12 ꯅꯤꯗ ꯂꯣꯏꯁꯤꯟꯕ ꯉꯝꯃꯤ꯫ ꯄꯨꯟꯅ ꯁꯨꯃꯤꯟꯅꯗꯨꯅ, ꯃꯈꯣꯏꯅ ꯊꯕꯛꯇꯨꯃꯛ ꯅꯨꯃꯤꯠ ꯀꯥꯌꯥꯅꯤꯗ ꯂꯣꯏꯁꯤꯟꯕ ꯉꯝꯒꯅꯤ?

english_text: 24. A and B together can do a piece of work in 10 days. A alone can do it in 30 days. The time in which B alone can do it is
bmei_text: A g B gn YbK AM numiT 10 nid tOb zMmi| A mYNtn YbKtu numiT 30 nid tOb zMmi| B mYNtn YbKtu tOb zMgdb mtM Adu:

english_text: 25. A and B together can complete a piece of work in 72 days, B and C together can complete it in 120 days, and A and C together in 90 days. In what time can A alone complete the work?
bmei_text: A g B gn YbK Am numiT 72 nid, B g C gn numiT 120 niud Adug A g C gn numiT 90 nid loIsiNb zMmi| A mYNtn YbKtu mtM kayaMgi mnuZd loIsiNb zMgni?
mayek_text: ꯑ ꯒ B ꯒꯅ ꯊꯕꯛ ꯑꯃ ꯅꯨꯃꯤꯠ 72 ꯅꯤꯗ, B ꯒ C ꯒꯅ ꯅꯨꯃꯤꯠ 120 ꯅꯤꯨꯗ ꯑꯗꯨꯒ ꯑ ꯒ C ꯒꯅ ꯅꯨꯃꯤꯠ 90 ꯅꯤꯗ ꯂꯣꯏꯁꯤꯟꯕ ꯉꯝꯃꯤ꯫ ꯑ ꯃꯊꯟꯇꯅ ꯊꯕꯛꯇꯨ ꯃꯇꯝ ꯀꯥꯌꯥꯝꯒꯤ ꯃꯅꯨꯡꯗ ꯂꯣꯏꯁꯤꯟꯕ ꯉꯝꯒꯅꯤ?

english_text: 26. A and B together can do a work in 8 days, B and C together in 6 days while C and A together in 10 days. If they all work together, the work will be completed in:
bmei_text: A g B gn YbK Am numiT 8 nid puNn tOb zMmi, B g C gn numiT 6 nid puNn tob zMmi, C g A gn numiT 10 nid zMb mtMd| mHoIn puNn tOmiNnrbdi, YbK Adu numiT kayanid loIsiNb zMgni?

english_text: 27. A and B can do a piece of work in 12 days, B and C in 8 days and C and A in 6 days. How long would B take to do the same work alone?
bmei_text: A g B gn YbK Am numiT 12 nid, B g C gn numiT 8 nid Adug C g A gn numiT 6 nid tOb zMmi| B mYNtn YbKtumK tObd kayaM kuIn cxgni?
mayek_text: ꯑ ꯒ B ꯒꯅ ꯊꯕꯛ ꯑꯃ ꯅꯨꯃꯤꯠ 12 ꯅꯤꯗ, B ꯒ C ꯒꯅ ꯅꯨꯃꯤꯠ 8 ꯅꯤꯗ ꯑꯗꯨꯒ C ꯒ ꯑ ꯒꯅ ꯅꯨꯃꯤꯠ 6 ꯅꯤꯗ ꯇꯧꯕ ꯉꯝꯃꯤ꯫ B ꯃꯊꯟꯇꯅ ꯊꯕꯛꯇꯨꯃꯛ ꯇꯧꯕꯗ ꯀꯥꯌꯥꯝ ꯀꯨꯏꯅ ꯆꯪꯒꯅꯤ?

english_text: 28. If A and B together can complete a work in 18 days, A and C together in 12 days and B and C together in 9 days, then B alone can do the work in:
bmei_text: A g B gn YbK AM numiT 18 nid, A g C gn numiT 12 nid Adug B g C gn numiT 9 nid loIsiNb zMlbdi, B mYNtn YbKtu numiT kayanid tOb zMgni?
mayek_text: ꯑ ꯒ B ꯒꯅ ꯊꯕꯛ ꯑꯝ ꯅꯨꯃꯤꯠ 18 ꯅꯤꯗ, ꯑ ꯒ C ꯒꯅ ꯅꯨꯃꯤꯠ 12 ꯅꯤꯗ ꯑꯗꯨꯒ B ꯒ C ꯒꯅ ꯅꯨꯃꯤꯠ 9 ꯅꯤꯗ ꯂꯣꯏꯁꯤꯟꯕ ꯉꯝꯂꯕꯗꯤ, B ꯃꯊꯟꯇꯅ ꯊꯕꯛꯇꯨ ꯅꯨꯃꯤꯠ ꯀꯥꯌꯥꯅꯤꯗ ꯇꯧꯕ ꯉꯝꯒꯅꯤ?

english_text: 29. A and B can do a piece of work in 10 days. B and C can do it in 12 days. C and A in 15 days. How many days will C finish it alone?
bmei_text: A g B gn YbK Am numiT 10 nid tOb zMmi| B g C gn numiT 12 nid zMmi| C g A gn numiT 15 nid zMmi| C mYNtn YbKtubu numiT kayanid loIsiNb zMgni?
mayek_text: ꯑ ꯒ B ꯒꯅ ꯊꯕꯛ ꯑꯃ ꯅꯨꯃꯤꯠ 10 ꯅꯤꯗ ꯇꯧꯕ ꯉꯝꯃꯤ꯫ B ꯒ C ꯒꯅ ꯅꯨꯃꯤꯠ 12 ꯅꯤꯗ ꯉꯝꯃꯤ꯫ C ꯒ ꯑ ꯒꯅ ꯅꯨꯃꯤꯠ 15 ꯅꯤꯗ ꯉꯝꯃꯤ꯫ C ꯃꯊꯟꯇꯅ ꯊꯕꯛꯇꯨꯕꯨ ꯅꯨꯃꯤꯠ ꯀꯥꯌꯥꯅꯤꯗ ꯂꯣꯏꯁꯤꯟꯕ ꯉꯝꯒꯅꯤ?

english_text: 30. If A and B together can complete a piece of work in 15 days and B alone in 20 days, in how many days can A alone complete the work?
bmei_text: A g B gn puNn YbK Am numiT 15 nid loiIsiNb zMlb AmsuZ B mYNtn numiT 20 nid zMlbdi, A mYNtn YbKtu numiT kayanid loIsiNb zMgni?
mayek_text: ꯑ ꯒ B ꯒꯅ ꯄꯨꯟꯅ ꯊꯕꯛ ꯑꯃ ꯅꯨꯃꯤꯠ 15 ꯅꯤꯗ ꯂꯣꯤꯏꯁꯤꯟꯕ ꯉꯝꯂꯕ ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ B ꯃꯊꯟꯇꯅ ꯅꯨꯃꯤꯠ 20 ꯅꯤꯗ ꯉꯝꯂꯕꯗꯤ, ꯑ ꯃꯊꯟꯇꯅ ꯊꯕꯛꯇꯨ ꯅꯨꯃꯤꯠ ꯀꯥꯌꯥꯅꯤꯗ ꯂꯣꯏꯁꯤꯟꯕ ꯉꯝꯒꯅꯤ?

bmei_text: YbK Am P Amdi Q n numiT 12 nid, Q g R gn numiT 15 nid R g P gn numiT 20 nid loIsiNb zMmi| numiT kayanid P mYNtn YbKtu loIsiNb zMgni?
mayek_text: ꯊꯕꯛ ꯑꯃ ꯞ ꯑꯃꯗꯤ Q ꯅ ꯅꯨꯃꯤꯠ 12 ꯅꯤꯗ, Q ꯒ R ꯒꯅ ꯅꯨꯃꯤꯠ 15 ꯅꯤꯗ R ꯒ ꯞ ꯒꯅ ꯅꯨꯃꯤꯠ 20 ꯅꯤꯗ ꯂꯣꯏꯁꯤꯟꯕ ꯉꯝꯃꯤ꯫ ꯅꯨꯃꯤꯠ ꯀꯥꯌꯥꯅꯤꯗ ꯞ ꯃꯊꯟꯇꯅ ꯊꯕꯛꯇꯨ ꯂꯣꯏꯁꯤꯟꯕ ꯉꯝꯒꯅꯤ?

english_text: 32. A and B can complete a piece of work in 8 days, B and C can do it in 12 days, C and A can do it in 8 days. A, B and C together can complete it in:
bmei_text: A g B gn YbK Am numiT 8 nid loIsiNb zMmi, B g C gn numiT 12 nid C g A gn numiT 8 nid zMmi| A, B AmsuZ C n puNn YbKtu numiT kayanid loIsiNb zMgni?
mayek_text: ꯑ ꯒ B ꯒꯅ ꯊꯕꯛ ꯑꯃ ꯅꯨꯃꯤꯠ 8 ꯅꯤꯗ ꯂꯣꯏꯁꯤꯟꯕ ꯉꯝꯃꯤ, B ꯒ C ꯒꯅ ꯅꯨꯃꯤꯠ 12 ꯅꯤꯗ C ꯒ ꯑ ꯒꯅ ꯅꯨꯃꯤꯠ 8 ꯅꯤꯗ ꯉꯝꯃꯤ꯫ ꯑ, B ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ C ꯅ ꯄꯨꯟꯅ ꯊꯕꯛꯇꯨ ꯅꯨꯃꯤꯠ ꯀꯥꯌꯥꯅꯤꯗ ꯂꯣꯏꯁꯤꯟꯕ ꯉꯝꯒꯅꯤ?

english_text: 33. A and B together can do a work in 10 days. B and C together can do the same work in 6 days. A and C together can do the work in 12 days. Then A, B and C together can do the work in:
bmei_text: A g B gn YbK Am numiT 10 nid tOb zMmi| B g C gn YbK AdumK numiT 6 nid tOb zMmi| A g C gn YbKtu numiT 12 nid zMmi| Adudi A, B AmsuZ C n YbKtu puNn numiT kayanid tOb zMgni?
mayek_text: ꯑ ꯒ B ꯒꯅ ꯊꯕꯛ ꯑꯃ ꯅꯨꯃꯤꯠ 10 ꯅꯤꯗ ꯇꯧꯕ ꯉꯝꯃꯤ꯫ B ꯒ C ꯒꯅ ꯊꯕꯛ ꯑꯗꯨꯃꯛ ꯅꯨꯃꯤꯠ 6 ꯅꯤꯗ ꯇꯧꯕ ꯉꯝꯃꯤ꯫ ꯑ ꯒ C ꯒꯅ ꯊꯕꯛꯇꯨ ꯅꯨꯃꯤꯠ 12 ꯅꯤꯗ ꯉꯝꯃꯤ꯫ ꯑꯗꯨꯗꯤ ꯑ, B ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ C ꯅ ꯊꯕꯛꯇꯨ ꯄꯨꯟꯅ ꯅꯨꯃꯤꯠ ꯀꯥꯌꯥꯅꯤꯗ ꯇꯧꯕ ꯉꯝꯒꯅꯤ?

english_text: 34. A, B and C together can complete a piece of work in 30 minutes. A and B together can complete the same work in 50 minutes. C alone can complete the work in:
bmei_text: A, B AmsuZ C n puNn YbK Am miniT 30 gi mnuZd loIsiNb zMmi| A g B gn YbK AdumK miniT 50 gi mnuZd loIsiNb zMmi| C mYNtn YbK Adu mtM kayaMgi mnuZd loIsiNb zMgni?
mayek_text: ꯑ, B ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ C ꯅ ꯄꯨꯟꯅ ꯊꯕꯛ ꯑꯃ ꯃꯤꯅꯤꯠ 30 ꯒꯤ ꯃꯅꯨꯡꯗ ꯂꯣꯏꯁꯤꯟꯕ ꯉꯝꯃꯤ꯫ ꯑ ꯒ B ꯒꯅ ꯊꯕꯛ ꯑꯗꯨꯃꯛ ꯃꯤꯅꯤꯠ 50 ꯒꯤ ꯃꯅꯨꯡꯗ ꯂꯣꯏꯁꯤꯟꯕ ꯉꯝꯃꯤ꯫ C ꯃꯊꯟꯇꯅ ꯊꯕꯛ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯃꯇꯝ ꯀꯥꯌꯥꯝꯒꯤ ꯃꯅꯨꯡꯗ ꯂꯣꯏꯁꯤꯟꯕ ꯉꯝꯒꯅꯤ?

english_text: 35. A and B can do a piece of work in 10 days. B and C can do it in 12 days. A and C can do it in 15 days. How long will A take to do it alone?
bmei_text: A g B gn YbK Am numiT 10 nid tOb zMmi| B g C gn numiT 12 nid zMmi| A g C gn numiT 15 nid zMmi| A mYNtn YbKtu tObd kayaM kuIn cxgni?
mayek_text: ꯑ ꯒ B ꯒꯅ ꯊꯕꯛ ꯑꯃ ꯅꯨꯃꯤꯠ 10 ꯅꯤꯗ ꯇꯧꯕ ꯉꯝꯃꯤ꯫ B ꯒ C ꯒꯅ ꯅꯨꯃꯤꯠ 12 ꯅꯤꯗ ꯉꯝꯃꯤ꯫ ꯑ ꯒ C ꯒꯅ ꯅꯨꯃꯤꯠ 15 ꯅꯤꯗ ꯉꯝꯃꯤ꯫ ꯑ ꯃꯊꯟꯇꯅ ꯊꯕꯛꯇꯨ ꯇꯧꯕꯗ ꯀꯥꯌꯥꯝ ꯀꯨꯏꯅ ꯆꯪꯒꯅꯤ?

english_text: 36. If A and B together can finish a piece of work in 20 days, B and C in 10 days and C and A in 12 days, then A, B, C jointly can finish the same work in:
bmei_text: A g B gn puNn YbK Am numiT 20 nid, B g C gn numiT 10 nid Adug C g A gn numiT 12 nid tOb zMmi| Adudi A, B, C n HuTsMndun YbK AdumK numiT kayanid tOb zMgni?
mayek_text: ꯑ ꯒ B ꯒꯅ ꯄꯨꯟꯅ ꯊꯕꯛ ꯑꯃ ꯅꯨꯃꯤꯠ 20 ꯅꯤꯗ, B ꯒ C ꯒꯅ ꯅꯨꯃꯤꯠ 10 ꯅꯤꯗ ꯑꯗꯨꯒ C ꯒ ꯑ ꯒꯅ ꯅꯨꯃꯤꯠ 12 ꯅꯤꯗ ꯇꯧꯕ ꯉꯝꯃꯤ꯫ ꯑꯗꯨꯗꯤ ꯑ, B, C ꯅ ꯈꯨꯠꯁꯝꯅꯗꯨꯅ ꯊꯕꯛ ꯑꯗꯨꯃꯛ ꯅꯨꯃꯤꯠ ꯀꯥꯌꯥꯅꯤꯗ ꯇꯧꯕ ꯉꯝꯒꯅꯤ?

english_text: 37. A, B and C individually can do a work in 10 days, 12 days and 15 days respectively. If they start working together, then the number of days required to finish the work is
bmei_text: A, B AmsuZ C tozaN-tozaNn mYx-siTn numiT 10 nid, 12 nid Amdi 15 nid tOb zMmi| mHoIn puNn YbK sub hOmiNnrbdi, YbKtu YbKtu loIsiNbd cxgdb numiT msiZ Adu:
mayek_text: ꯑ, B ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ C ꯇꯣꯉꯥꯟ-ꯇꯣꯉꯥꯟꯅ ꯃꯊꯪ-ꯁꯤꯠꯅ ꯅꯨꯃꯤꯠ 10 ꯅꯤꯗ, 12 ꯅꯤꯗ ꯑꯃꯗꯤ 15 ꯅꯤꯗ ꯇꯧꯕ ꯉꯝꯃꯤ꯫ ꯃꯈꯣꯏꯅ ꯄꯨꯟꯅ ꯊꯕꯛ ꯁꯨꯕ ꯍꯧꯃꯤꯟꯅꯔꯕꯗꯤ, ꯊꯕꯛꯇꯨ ꯊꯕꯛꯇꯨ ꯂꯣꯏꯁꯤꯟꯕꯗ ꯆꯪꯒꯗꯕ ꯅꯨꯃꯤꯠ ꯃꯁꯤꯡ ꯑꯗꯨ:

english_text: 38. A and B together can do a piece of work in 12 days, while B alone can finish it in 30 days. A alone can finish the work in:
bmei_text: A g B gn puNn YbK Am numiT 12 nid tOb zMmi B mYNtn numiT 30 nid loIsiNb zMb kaNd| A mYNtn YbKtu numiT kayanid loIsiNb zMgni?
mayek_text: ꯑ ꯒ B ꯒꯅ ꯄꯨꯟꯅ ꯊꯕꯛ ꯑꯃ ꯅꯨꯃꯤꯠ 12 ꯅꯤꯗ ꯇꯧꯕ ꯉꯝꯃꯤ B ꯃꯊꯟꯇꯅ ꯅꯨꯃꯤꯠ 30 ꯅꯤꯗ ꯂꯣꯏꯁꯤꯟꯕ ꯉꯝꯕ ꯀꯥꯟꯗ꯫ ꯑ ꯃꯊꯟꯇꯅ ꯊꯕꯛꯇꯨ ꯅꯨꯃꯤꯠ ꯀꯥꯌꯥꯅꯤꯗ ꯂꯣꯏꯁꯤꯟꯕ ꯉꯝꯒꯅꯤ?

english_text: 39. A, B and C can complete a piece of work in 12, 24 and 36 days respectively. In how many days will they together complete the same work?
bmei_text: A, B AmsuZ C YbK Am mYx-siTn numiT 12, 24 Amdi 36 nigi mnuZd loIsiNb zMmi| mHoIn puNn numiT kayanidi mnuZd YbK AdumK loIsiNb zMgni?
mayek_text: ꯑ, B ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ C ꯊꯕꯛ ꯑꯃ ꯃꯊꯪ-ꯁꯤꯠꯅ ꯅꯨꯃꯤꯠ 12, 24 ꯑꯃꯗꯤ 36 ꯅꯤꯒꯤ ꯃꯅꯨꯡꯗ ꯂꯣꯏꯁꯤꯟꯕ ꯉꯝꯃꯤ꯫ ꯃꯈꯣꯏꯅ ꯄꯨꯟꯅ ꯅꯨꯃꯤꯠ ꯀꯥꯌꯥꯅꯤꯗꯤ ꯃꯅꯨꯡꯗ ꯊꯕꯛ ꯑꯗꯨꯃꯛ ꯂꯣꯏꯁꯤꯟꯕ ꯉꯝꯒꯅꯤ?

english_text: 40. A and B can separately do a piece of work in 6 days and 12 days respectively. How long will they together take to do the work?
bmei_text: A g B g tozaN-tozaNn YbK Am mYx-siTn numiT 6 nid AmsuZ 12 nid tOb zMmi| mHoIn puNn tOmiNnrg YbKtu tObd kayaM kuIn cxgni?
mayek_text: ꯑ ꯒ B ꯒ ꯇꯣꯉꯥꯟ-ꯇꯣꯉꯥꯟꯅ ꯊꯕꯛ ꯑꯃ ꯃꯊꯪ-ꯁꯤꯠꯅ ꯅꯨꯃꯤꯠ 6 ꯅꯤꯗ ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ 12 ꯅꯤꯗ ꯇꯧꯕ ꯉꯝꯃꯤ꯫ ꯃꯈꯣꯏꯅ ꯄꯨꯟꯅ ꯇꯧꯃꯤꯟꯅꯔꯒ ꯊꯕꯛꯇꯨ ꯇꯧꯕꯗ ꯀꯥꯌꯥꯝ ꯀꯨꯏꯅ ꯆꯪꯒꯅꯤ?

english_text: 41. A and B can do a piece of work in 36 days, B and C can do it in 60 days, A and C can do it in 45 days. C alone can do it in:
bmei_text: A g B gn YbK Am numiT 36 nid tOb zMmi, B g C gn numiT 60 nid, A g C gn numiT 45 nid tOb zMmi| C mYNtn YbKtu numiT kayanid tOb zMgdge?
mayek_text: ꯑ ꯒ B ꯒꯅ ꯊꯕꯛ ꯑꯃ ꯅꯨꯃꯤꯠ 36 ꯅꯤꯗ ꯇꯧꯕ ꯉꯝꯃꯤ, B ꯒ C ꯒꯅ ꯅꯨꯃꯤꯠ 60 ꯅꯤꯗ, ꯑ ꯒ C ꯒꯅ ꯅꯨꯃꯤꯠ 45 ꯅꯤꯗ ꯇꯧꯕ ꯉꯝꯃꯤ꯫ C ꯃꯊꯟꯇꯅ ꯊꯕꯛꯇꯨ ꯅꯨꯃꯤꯠ ꯀꯥꯌꯥꯅꯤꯗ ꯇꯧꯕ ꯉꯝꯒꯗꯒꯦ?

english_text: 42. A and B together can dig a trench in 12 days, which A alone can dig it in 28 days. B alone can dig it in:
bmei_text: A mYNtn numiT 28 nid tOb zMb guhadu A g B gn numiT 12 nid tOb zMmi| B mYNtn guhadu numiT kayanid tOb zMgni?
mayek_text: ꯑ ꯃꯊꯟꯇꯅ ꯅꯨꯃꯤꯠ 28 ꯅꯤꯗ ꯇꯧꯕ ꯉꯝꯕ ꯒꯨꯍꯥꯗꯨ ꯑ ꯒ B ꯒꯅ ꯅꯨꯃꯤꯠ 12 ꯅꯤꯗ ꯇꯧꯕ ꯉꯝꯃꯤ꯫ B ꯃꯊꯟꯇꯅ ꯒꯨꯍꯥꯗꯨ ꯅꯨꯃꯤꯠ ꯀꯥꯌꯥꯅꯤꯗ ꯇꯧꯕ ꯉꯝꯒꯅꯤ?

english_text: 43. A can complete a work in ‘m’ days and B can complete it in ‘n’ days. How many days will it take to complete the work if both A and B work together?
bmei_text: A n YbK Am numiT ‘m’ gi mnuZd tOb zMmi Adug B ndi numiT ‘n’ gi mnuZd tOb zMmi| A g B gn puNn tOmiNnrbdi, mHoIn YbKtu loIsiNbd numiT kayani cxgni?
mayek_text: ꯑ ꯅ ꯊꯕꯛ ꯑꯃ ꯅꯨꯃꯤꯠ ‘ꯃ’ ꯒꯤ ꯃꯅꯨꯡꯗ ꯇꯧꯕ ꯉꯝꯃꯤ ꯑꯗꯨꯒ B ꯅꯗꯤ ꯅꯨꯃꯤꯠ ‘ꯅ’ ꯒꯤ ꯃꯅꯨꯡꯗ ꯇꯧꯕ ꯉꯝꯃꯤ꯫ ꯑ ꯒ B ꯒꯅ ꯄꯨꯟꯅ ꯇꯧꯃꯤꯟꯅꯔꯕꯗꯤ, ꯃꯈꯣꯏꯅ ꯊꯕꯛꯇꯨ ꯂꯣꯏꯁꯤꯟꯕꯗ ꯅꯨꯃꯤꯠ ꯀꯥꯌꯥꯅꯤ ꯆꯪꯒꯅꯤ?

english_text: 44. If x can finish a job in 4 hours and y can finish the same job in 8 hours independently, then they together will finish the job in:
bmei_text: x n YbK Am puZ 4 gi Adug y n puZ 8 gi mnuZd tozaN-tozaNn loIsiNb zMlbdi, mHoIn puNn YbKtu mtM kayagi mnuZd loIsiNb zMgni?
mayek_text: x ꯅ ꯊꯕꯛ ꯑꯃ ꯄꯨꯡ 4 ꯒꯤ ꯑꯗꯨꯒ ꯌ ꯅ ꯄꯨꯡ 8 ꯒꯤ ꯃꯅꯨꯡꯗ ꯇꯣꯉꯥꯟ-ꯇꯣꯉꯥꯟꯅ ꯂꯣꯏꯁꯤꯟꯕ ꯉꯝꯂꯕꯗꯤ, ꯃꯈꯣꯏꯅ ꯄꯨꯟꯅ ꯊꯕꯛꯇꯨ ꯃꯇꯝ ꯀꯥꯌꯥꯒꯤ ꯃꯅꯨꯡꯗ ꯂꯣꯏꯁꯤꯟꯕ ꯉꯝꯒꯅꯤ?

english_text: 45. x can copy 80 pages in 20 hours, x and y together can copy 135 pages in 27 hours. Then y can copy 20 pages in:
bmei_text: x n lamaI 80 puZ 20 gi mnuiZd siNb zMmi, x k y n puNn puZ 27 gi mnuZd lamaI 135 siNb zMmi| Adudi y n lamaI 20 mtM kayaMgi mnuZd siNb zMgni?
mayek_text: x ꯅ ꯂꯥꯃꯥꯏ 80 ꯄꯨꯡ 20 ꯒꯤ ꯃꯅꯨꯤꯡꯗ ꯁꯤꯟꯕ ꯉꯝꯃꯤ, x ꯀ ꯌ ꯅ ꯄꯨꯟꯅ ꯄꯨꯡ 27 ꯒꯤ ꯃꯅꯨꯡꯗ ꯂꯥꯃꯥꯏ 135 ꯁꯤꯟꯕ ꯉꯝꯃꯤ꯫ ꯑꯗꯨꯗꯤ ꯌ ꯅ ꯂꯥꯃꯥꯏ 20 ꯃꯇꯝ ꯀꯥꯌꯥꯝꯒꯤ ꯃꯅꯨꯡꯗ ꯁꯤꯟꯕ ꯉꯝꯒꯅꯤ?

english_text: 46. A and B can do a piece of work in 15 days. B and C can do a similar work in 12 days and C and A in 10 days. How many days will A take to do the work by himself?
bmei_text: A g B g YbK Am numiT 15 nid tOb zMmi| B g C gn maNnb YbK Am numiT 12 nid Adug C g A gn numiT 10 nid tOb zMmi| A n msa mYNtn surg YbKtu tObd numiT kayani cxgni?
mayek_text: ꯑ ꯒ B ꯒ ꯊꯕꯛ ꯑꯃ ꯅꯨꯃꯤꯠ 15 ꯅꯤꯗ ꯇꯧꯕ ꯉꯝꯃꯤ꯫ B ꯒ C ꯒꯅ ꯃꯥꯟꯅꯕ ꯊꯕꯛ ꯑꯃ ꯅꯨꯃꯤꯠ 12 ꯅꯤꯗ ꯑꯗꯨꯒ C ꯒ ꯑ ꯒꯅ ꯅꯨꯃꯤꯠ 10 ꯅꯤꯗ ꯇꯧꯕ ꯉꯝꯃꯤ꯫ ꯑ ꯅ ꯃꯁꯥ ꯃꯊꯟꯇꯅ ꯁꯨꯔꯒ ꯊꯕꯛꯇꯨ ꯇꯧꯕꯗ ꯅꯨꯃꯤꯠ ꯀꯥꯌꯥꯅꯤ ꯆꯪꯒꯅꯤ?

english_text: 47. A can do a piece of work in 25 days and B can do the same work in 30 days. They work together for 5 days, how much of work is left?
bmei_text: A n YbK Am numiT 25 nid tOb zMmi Adug B n numiT 30 nid zMmi| mHoIn puNn numiT 5 ni YbKtu tOmiNnre, Adudi YbK kayaM leMhOribge?
mayek_text: ꯑ ꯅ ꯊꯕꯛ ꯑꯃ ꯅꯨꯃꯤꯠ 25 ꯅꯤꯗ ꯇꯧꯕ ꯉꯝꯃꯤ ꯑꯗꯨꯒ B ꯅ ꯅꯨꯃꯤꯠ 30 ꯅꯤꯗ ꯉꯝꯃꯤ꯫ ꯃꯈꯣꯏꯅ ꯄꯨꯟꯅ ꯅꯨꯃꯤꯠ 5 ꯅꯤ ꯊꯕꯛꯇꯨ ꯇꯧꯃꯤꯟꯅꯔꯦ, ꯑꯗꯨꯗꯤ ꯊꯕꯛ ꯀꯥꯌꯥꯝ ꯂꯦꯝꯍꯧꯔꯤꯕꯒꯦ?

english_text: 48. A and B can do a piece of work in 15 days. B and C can do the same work in 10 days and A and C can do the same in 12 days. Time taken by A, B and C together to do the job is
bmei_text: A g B gn YbK Am numiT 15 nid tOb zMmi| B g C gn numiT 10 nid Adug A g C gn numiT 12 nid tOb zMmi| A, B AmsuZ C n puNn YbKtu tObd cxgdb mtM Adu:
mayek_text: ꯑ ꯒ B ꯒꯅ ꯊꯕꯛ ꯑꯃ ꯅꯨꯃꯤꯠ 15 ꯅꯤꯗ ꯇꯧꯕ ꯉꯝꯃꯤ꯫ B ꯒ C ꯒꯅ ꯅꯨꯃꯤꯠ 10 ꯅꯤꯗ ꯑꯗꯨꯒ ꯑ ꯒ C ꯒꯅ ꯅꯨꯃꯤꯠ 12 ꯅꯤꯗ ꯇꯧꯕ ꯉꯝꯃꯤ꯫ ꯑ, B ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ C ꯅ ꯄꯨꯟꯅ ꯊꯕꯛꯇꯨ ꯇꯧꯕꯗ ꯆꯪꯒꯗꯕ ꯃꯇꯝ ꯑꯗꯨ:

english_text: 49. A, B and C can complete a piece of work in 24, 5 and 12 days respectively. Working together, they will complete the same work in:
bmei_text: A, B AmsuZ C n YbK Am mYx-siTn numiT 24, 5 AmsuZ 12 nidi mnuZd loIsiNb zMmi| puNn tOmiNnrg, mHoIn YbKtu numiT kayanid loIsiNb zMgni?
mayek_text: ꯑ, B ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ C ꯅ ꯊꯕꯛ ꯑꯃ ꯃꯊꯪ-ꯁꯤꯠꯅ ꯅꯨꯃꯤꯠ 24, 5 ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ 12 ꯅꯤꯗꯤ ꯃꯅꯨꯡꯗ ꯂꯣꯏꯁꯤꯟꯕ ꯉꯝꯃꯤ꯫ ꯄꯨꯟꯅ ꯇꯧꯃꯤꯟꯅꯔꯒ, ꯃꯈꯣꯏꯅ ꯊꯕꯛꯇꯨ ꯅꯨꯃꯤꯠ ꯀꯥꯌꯥꯅꯤꯗ ꯂꯣꯏꯁꯤꯟꯕ ꯉꯝꯒꯅꯤ?

english_text: 50. A can do a piece of work in 9 days while B can do it in 12 days. A and B together can do the work in:
bmei_text: A n YbK Am numiT 9 nid tOb zMmi B n numiT 12 nid zMb mtMd| A g B gn puNn YbKtu numiT kayanid tOb zMgni?
mayek_text: ꯑ ꯅ ꯊꯕꯛ ꯑꯃ ꯅꯨꯃꯤꯠ 9 ꯅꯤꯗ ꯇꯧꯕ ꯉꯝꯃꯤ B ꯅ ꯅꯨꯃꯤꯠ 12 ꯅꯤꯗ ꯉꯝꯕ ꯃꯇꯝꯗ꯫ ꯑ ꯒ B ꯒꯅ ꯄꯨꯟꯅ ꯊꯕꯛꯇꯨ ꯅꯨꯃꯤꯠ ꯀꯥꯌꯥꯅꯤꯗ ꯇꯧꯕ ꯉꯝꯒꯅꯤ?

english_text: 51. A man can do a piece of work in 30 hours. If he works with his son then the same piece of work is finished in 20 hours. If the son works alone he can do the work in
bmei_text: nupa Amn YbK Am puZ 30 gi mnuZd tOb zMmi| mcanupag tOmiNnrbdi, YbKtu puz 20 gi mnuZd loIsiNb zMmi| mcanupadun mYNtn surbdi, mhaKn YbKtu puz kayagi mnuZd tOb zMgni?
mayek_text: ꯅꯨꯄꯥ ꯑꯃꯅ ꯊꯕꯛ ꯑꯃ ꯄꯨꯡ 30 ꯒꯤ ꯃꯅꯨꯡꯗ ꯇꯧꯕ ꯉꯝꯃꯤ꯫ ꯃꯆꯥꯅꯨꯄꯥꯒ ꯇꯧꯃꯤꯟꯅꯔꯕꯗꯤ, ꯊꯕꯛꯇꯨ ꯄꯨꯉ 20 ꯒꯤ ꯃꯅꯨꯡꯗ ꯂꯣꯏꯁꯤꯟꯕ ꯉꯝꯃꯤ꯫ ꯃꯆꯥꯅꯨꯄꯥꯗꯨꯅ ꯃꯊꯟꯇꯅ ꯁꯨꯔꯕꯗꯤ, ꯃꯍꯥꯛꯅ ꯊꯕꯛꯇꯨ ꯄꯨꯉ ꯀꯥꯌꯥꯒꯤ ꯃꯅꯨꯡꯗ ꯇꯧꯕ ꯉꯝꯒꯅꯤ?

english_text: 52. A and B together can finish a job in 24 days, while A, B and C together can finish the same job in 8 days. C alone will finish the job in
bmei_text: A, B Amdi C n puNn YbK Am numiT 8 nid loIsiNb zMb mtMd A g B gn puNn YbK Adu numiT 24 nid loIsiNb zMmi| C mYNtn YbKtu numiT kayanid loIsiNb zMgni?
mayek_text: ꯑ, B ꯑꯃꯗꯤ C ꯅ ꯄꯨꯟꯅ ꯊꯕꯛ ꯑꯃ ꯅꯨꯃꯤꯠ 8 ꯅꯤꯗ ꯂꯣꯏꯁꯤꯟꯕ ꯉꯝꯕ ꯃꯇꯝꯗ ꯑ ꯒ B ꯒꯅ ꯄꯨꯟꯅ ꯊꯕꯛ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯅꯨꯃꯤꯠ 24 ꯅꯤꯗ ꯂꯣꯏꯁꯤꯟꯕ ꯉꯝꯃꯤ꯫ C ꯃꯊꯟꯇꯅ ꯊꯕꯛꯇꯨ ꯅꯨꯃꯤꯠ ꯀꯥꯌꯥꯅꯤꯗ ꯂꯣꯏꯁꯤꯟꯕ ꯉꯝꯒꯅꯤ?

english_text: 53. A and B together can do a piece of work in 6 days and A alone can do it in 9 days. The number of days B will take to do it alone is:
bmei_text: A g B g puNn YbK Am numiT 6 nid tOb zMmi AmsuZ A mYNtn numiT 9 nid zMmi| B mYNtn YbKtu tObd cxgdb numiT msiZ Adu:
mayek_text: ꯑ ꯒ B ꯒ ꯄꯨꯟꯅ ꯊꯕꯛ ꯑꯃ ꯅꯨꯃꯤꯠ 6 ꯅꯤꯗ ꯇꯧꯕ ꯉꯝꯃꯤ ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯑ ꯃꯊꯟꯇꯅ ꯅꯨꯃꯤꯠ 9 ꯅꯤꯗ ꯉꯝꯃꯤ꯫ B ꯃꯊꯟꯇꯅ ꯊꯕꯛꯇꯨ ꯇꯧꯕꯗ ꯆꯪꯒꯗꯕ ꯅꯨꯃꯤꯠ ꯃꯁꯤꯡ ꯑꯗꯨ:

english_text: 54. If 100 cats kill 100 mice in 100 days, then 4 cats would kill 4 mice in how many days?
bmei_text: hOdoZ 100 n Uci 100 numiT 100 nid haTp zMlbdi, hOdoZ 4 n Uci 4 numiT kayanigi mnuZd haTp zMgni?
mayek_text: ꯍꯧꯗꯣꯡ 100 ꯅ ꯎꯆꯤ 100 ꯅꯨꯃꯤꯠ 100 ꯅꯤꯗ ꯍꯥꯠꯄ ꯉꯝꯂꯕꯗꯤ, ꯍꯧꯗꯣꯡ 4 ꯅ ꯎꯆꯤ 4 ꯅꯨꯃꯤꯠ ꯀꯥꯌꯥꯅꯤꯒꯤ ꯃꯅꯨꯡꯗ ꯍꯥꯠꯄ ꯉꯝꯒꯅꯤ?

english_text: 55. X can do a piece of work in ‘p’ days and Y can do the same work in ‘q’ days. Then the number of days in which X and Y can together do that work is
bmei_text: X n YbK Am numiT ‘p’ nigi mnuZd tOb zMmi AmsuZ Y n numiT ‘q’ nigi mnuZd tOb zMmi| X k Y g puNn YbKtu tOmiNnb zMdOb numiT msiZ Adu:
mayek_text: X ꯅ ꯊꯕꯛ ꯑꯃ ꯅꯨꯃꯤꯠ ‘ꯄ’ ꯅꯤꯒꯤ ꯃꯅꯨꯡꯗ ꯇꯧꯕ ꯉꯝꯃꯤ ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯊ ꯅ ꯅꯨꯃꯤꯠ ‘q’ ꯅꯤꯒꯤ ꯃꯅꯨꯡꯗ ꯇꯧꯕ ꯉꯝꯃꯤ꯫ X ꯀ ꯊ ꯒ ꯄꯨꯟꯅ ꯊꯕꯛꯇꯨ ꯇꯧꯃꯤꯟꯅꯕ ꯉꯝꯗꯧꯕ ꯅꯨꯃꯤꯠ ꯃꯁꯤꯡ ꯑꯗꯨ:

english_text: 56. A and B together can do a piece of work in 36 days, B and C together can do it in 24 days. A and C together can do it in 18 days. The three working together can finish the work in
bmei_text: A g B gn puNn YbK Am numiT 36 nid tOb zMmi, B g C gn numiT 24 nid puNn tOb zMmi| A g C gn YbKtu numiT 18 nid tOb zMmi| mHoI AhuMn puNn YbKtu numiT kayanid loIsiNb zMgni?
mayek_text: ꯑ ꯒ B ꯒꯅ ꯄꯨꯟꯅ ꯊꯕꯛ ꯑꯃ ꯅꯨꯃꯤꯠ 36 ꯅꯤꯗ ꯇꯧꯕ ꯉꯝꯃꯤ, B ꯒ C ꯒꯅ ꯅꯨꯃꯤꯠ 24 ꯅꯤꯗ ꯄꯨꯟꯅ ꯇꯧꯕ ꯉꯝꯃꯤ꯫ ꯑ ꯒ C ꯒꯅ ꯊꯕꯛꯇꯨ ꯅꯨꯃꯤꯠ 18 ꯅꯤꯗ ꯇꯧꯕ ꯉꯝꯃꯤ꯫ ꯃꯈꯣꯏ ꯑꯍꯨꯝꯅ ꯄꯨꯟꯅ ꯊꯕꯛꯇꯨ ꯅꯨꯃꯤꯠ ꯀꯥꯌꯥꯅꯤꯗ ꯂꯣꯏꯁꯤꯟꯕ ꯉꯝꯒꯅꯤ?

english_text: 57. A canal of a village can be cleaned by 24 villagers in 12 days. The number of days in which 36 villagers can clean the canal is
bmei_text: HuZgx Amgi nala Amsi miAoI 24 n numiT 12 nid seZdoKp zMmi| miAoI 36 n naladu seZdoKp zMgdb numiT msiZ Adu:
mayek_text: ꯈꯨꯡꯒꯪ ꯑꯃꯒꯤ ꯅꯥꯂꯥ ꯑꯃꯁꯤ ꯃꯤꯑꯣꯏ 24 ꯅ ꯅꯨꯃꯤꯠ 12 ꯅꯤꯗ ꯁꯦꯡꯗꯣꯛꯄ ꯉꯝꯃꯤ꯫ ꯃꯤꯑꯣꯏ 36 ꯅ ꯅꯥꯂꯥꯗꯨ ꯁꯦꯡꯗꯣꯛꯄ ꯉꯝꯒꯗꯕ ꯅꯨꯃꯤꯠ ꯃꯁꯤꯡ ꯑꯗꯨ:

english_text: 58. A and B can do a piece of work in 18 days, B and C in 24 days, A and C in 36 days. Working together they can do the work in
bmei_text: A g B gn YbK Am numiT 18 nid tOb zMmi, B g C gn numiT 24 nid, A g C gn numiT 36 nid| puNn sumiNnrg, mHoIn YbKtu numiT kayanid tOb zMgni?
mayek_text: ꯑ ꯒ B ꯒꯅ ꯊꯕꯛ ꯑꯃ ꯅꯨꯃꯤꯠ 18 ꯅꯤꯗ ꯇꯧꯕ ꯉꯝꯃꯤ, B ꯒ C ꯒꯅ ꯅꯨꯃꯤꯠ 24 ꯅꯤꯗ, ꯑ ꯒ C ꯒꯅ ꯅꯨꯃꯤꯠ 36 ꯅꯤꯗ꯫ ꯄꯨꯟꯅ ꯁꯨꯃꯤꯟꯅꯔꯒ, ꯃꯈꯣꯏꯅ ꯊꯕꯛꯇꯨ ꯅꯨꯃꯤꯠ ꯀꯥꯌꯥꯅꯤꯗ ꯇꯧꯕ ꯉꯝꯒꯅꯤ?

english_text: 59. If 42 persons consume 144 kg of wheat in 15 days, then in how many days will 30 persons consume 45 kg of wheat?
bmei_text: miAoI 42 n numiT 15 nid gehu 144 kg cab zMlbdi, miAoI 30 gehu 45 kg si numiT kayanid cab zMgni?
mayek_text: ꯃꯤꯑꯣꯏ 42 ꯅ ꯅꯨꯃꯤꯠ 15 ꯅꯤꯗ ꯒꯦꯍꯨ 144 ꯀꯒ ꯆꯥꯕ ꯉꯝꯂꯕꯗꯤ, ꯃꯤꯑꯣꯏ 30 ꯒꯦꯍꯨ 45 ꯀꯒ ꯁꯤ ꯅꯨꯃꯤꯠ ꯀꯥꯌꯥꯅꯤꯗ ꯆꯥꯕ ꯉꯝꯒꯅꯤ?

english_text: 60. If 5 persons together can make 5 mats in 5 hours, then 10 persons in 10 hours will make
bmei_text: miAoI 5 n puNn fK 5 puZ 5 gi mnuZd loNb zMlbdi, puZ 10 gi mnuZd miAoI 10 n kaya loNb zMgni?
mayek_text: ꯃꯤꯑꯣꯏ 5 ꯅ ꯄꯨꯟꯅ ꯐꯛ 5 ꯄꯨꯡ 5 ꯒꯤ ꯃꯅꯨꯡꯗ ꯂꯣꯟꯕ ꯉꯝꯂꯕꯗꯤ, ꯄꯨꯡ 10 ꯒꯤ ꯃꯅꯨꯡꯗ ꯃꯤꯑꯣꯏ 10 ꯅ ꯀꯥꯌꯥ ꯂꯣꯟꯕ ꯉꯝꯒꯅꯤ?

english_text: 61. A and B together can do a piece of work in 12 days while A alone can do the same work in 30 days. B alone can do it in
bmei_text: A g B gn puNn YbK Am numiT 12 nid tOb zMmi A mYNtn numiT 30 nid tOb zMb kaNd| B mYNtn YbKtu numiT kayanid tOb zMgni?
mayek_text: ꯑ ꯒ B ꯒꯅ ꯄꯨꯟꯅ ꯊꯕꯛ ꯑꯃ ꯅꯨꯃꯤꯠ 12 ꯅꯤꯗ ꯇꯧꯕ ꯉꯝꯃꯤ ꯑ ꯃꯊꯟꯇꯅ ꯅꯨꯃꯤꯠ 30 ꯅꯤꯗ ꯇꯧꯕ ꯉꯝꯕ ꯀꯥꯟꯗ꯫ B ꯃꯊꯟꯇꯅ ꯊꯕꯛꯇꯨ ꯅꯨꯃꯤꯠ ꯀꯥꯌꯥꯅꯤꯗ ꯇꯧꯕ ꯉꯝꯒꯅꯤ?

english_text: 62. A and B can do a piece of work in 72 days. B and C can do it in 120 days and A and C can do it in 90 days. A alone can do it in:
bmei_text: A g B gn YbK Am numiT 72 nid tOb zMmi| B g C gn numiT 120 nid zMmi Adug A g C gn numiT 90 nid zMmi| A mYNtn YbKtu numiT kayanid tOb zMgni?
mayek_text: ꯑ ꯒ B ꯒꯅ ꯊꯕꯛ ꯑꯃ ꯅꯨꯃꯤꯠ 72 ꯅꯤꯗ ꯇꯧꯕ ꯉꯝꯃꯤ꯫ B ꯒ C ꯒꯅ ꯅꯨꯃꯤꯠ 120 ꯅꯤꯗ ꯉꯝꯃꯤ ꯑꯗꯨꯒ ꯑ ꯒ C ꯒꯅ ꯅꯨꯃꯤꯠ 90 ꯅꯤꯗ ꯉꯝꯃꯤ꯫ ꯑ ꯃꯊꯟꯇꯅ ꯊꯕꯛꯇꯨ ꯅꯨꯃꯤꯠ ꯀꯥꯌꯥꯅꯤꯗ ꯇꯧꯕ ꯉꯝꯒꯅꯤ?

english_text: 63. If 35 men can finish a piece of work in 8 days, then the number of men who can do the same work in 10 days is:
bmei_text: nupa 35 n YbK Am numiT 8 nid loIsiNb zMlbdi, numiT 10 nid YbKtu tOb zMgdb nupa msiZ Adu:
mayek_text: ꯅꯨꯄꯥ 35 ꯅ ꯊꯕꯛ ꯑꯃ ꯅꯨꯃꯤꯠ 8 ꯅꯤꯗ ꯂꯣꯏꯁꯤꯟꯕ ꯉꯝꯂꯕꯗꯤ, ꯅꯨꯃꯤꯠ 10 ꯅꯤꯗ ꯊꯕꯛꯇꯨ ꯇꯧꯕ ꯉꯝꯒꯗꯕ ꯅꯨꯄꯥ ꯃꯁꯤꯡ ꯑꯗꯨ:

english_text: 64. A and B can do a work in 18 and 24 days respectively. They worked together for 8 days and then A left. The remaining work was finished by B in:
bmei_text: A g B gn YbK Am mYx-siTn numiT 18 Amdi 24 nid tOb zMmi| mHoIn puNn numiT 8 ni sumiNnre Adug A di toKlg cTHr_e| leMhOrib YbKtu B n numiT kayanigi mnuZd loIsiNb zMgni?
mayek_text: ꯑ ꯒ B ꯒꯅ ꯊꯕꯛ ꯑꯃ ꯃꯊꯪ-ꯁꯤꯠꯅ ꯅꯨꯃꯤꯠ 18 ꯑꯃꯗꯤ 24 ꯅꯤꯗ ꯇꯧꯕ ꯉꯝꯃꯤ꯫ ꯃꯈꯣꯏꯅ ꯄꯨꯟꯅ ꯅꯨꯃꯤꯠ 8 ꯅꯤ ꯁꯨꯃꯤꯟꯅꯔꯦ ꯑꯗꯨꯒ ꯑ ꯗꯤ ꯇꯣꯛꯂꯒ ꯆꯠꯈ꯭ꯔꯦ꯫ ꯂꯦꯝꯍꯧꯔꯤꯕ ꯊꯕꯛꯇꯨ B ꯅ ꯅꯨꯃꯤꯠ ꯀꯥꯌꯥꯅꯤꯒꯤ ꯃꯅꯨꯡꯗ ꯂꯣꯏꯁꯤꯟꯕ ꯉꯝꯒꯅꯤ?

english_text: 65. A can do a piece of work in 20 days which B can do in 12 days. B worked at it for 9 days. A can finish the remaining work in
bmei_text: A n YbK Am numiT 20 nid tOb zMmi B n numiT 12 nid tOb zMb YbKtu| B n numiT 9 ni YbKtu sure| A n leMhOrib YbKtu numiT kayanid loIsiNb zMgni?
mayek_text: ꯑ ꯅ ꯊꯕꯛ ꯑꯃ ꯅꯨꯃꯤꯠ 20 ꯅꯤꯗ ꯇꯧꯕ ꯉꯝꯃꯤ B ꯅ ꯅꯨꯃꯤꯠ 12 ꯅꯤꯗ ꯇꯧꯕ ꯉꯝꯕ ꯊꯕꯛꯇꯨ꯫ B ꯅ ꯅꯨꯃꯤꯠ 9 ꯅꯤ ꯊꯕꯛꯇꯨ ꯁꯨꯔꯦ꯫ ꯑ ꯅ ꯂꯦꯝꯍꯧꯔꯤꯕ ꯊꯕꯛꯇꯨ ꯅꯨꯃꯤꯠ ꯀꯥꯌꯥꯅꯤꯗ ꯂꯣꯏꯁꯤꯟꯕ ꯉꯝꯒꯅꯤ?

english_text: 66. A can finish a work in 18 days and B can do the same work in 5 days. B worked for 10 days and left the job. In how many days, A alone can finish the remaining work?
bmei_text: A n YbK Am numiT 18 nid tOb zMmi Adug B n YbK AdumK numiT 5 nid tOb zMmi| B n numiT 10 ni surg YadoKtun cTHr_e| numiT kayanid A mYNtn leMhOrib YbKtu loIsiNb zMgni?
mayek_text: ꯑ ꯅ ꯊꯕꯛ ꯑꯃ ꯅꯨꯃꯤꯠ 18 ꯅꯤꯗ ꯇꯧꯕ ꯉꯝꯃꯤ ꯑꯗꯨꯒ B ꯅ ꯊꯕꯛ ꯑꯗꯨꯃꯛ ꯅꯨꯃꯤꯠ 5 ꯅꯤꯗ ꯇꯧꯕ ꯉꯝꯃꯤ꯫ B ꯅ ꯅꯨꯃꯤꯠ 10 ꯅꯤ ꯁꯨꯔꯒ ꯊꯥꯗꯣꯛꯇꯨꯅ ꯆꯠꯈ꯭ꯔꯦ꯫ ꯅꯨꯃꯤꯠ ꯀꯥꯌꯥꯅꯤꯗ ꯑ ꯃꯊꯟꯇꯅ ꯂꯦꯝꯍꯧꯔꯤꯕ ꯊꯕꯛꯇꯨ ꯂꯣꯏꯁꯤꯟꯕ ꯉꯝꯒꯅꯤ?

english_text: 67. A certain number of men complete a piece of work in 60 days. If there were 8 men more, the work could be finished in 10 days less. The number of men originally was
bmei_text: kriguMb nupa msiZ Hrn YbK Am numiT 60 nid loIsiNb zMmi| nupa 8 heNn yaUrbdi, YbKtu numiT 10 ni hNYn loIsiNb zMgni| haNn yaUrMb nupa msiZ Adu:
mayek_text: ꯀꯔꯤꯒꯨꯝꯕ ꯅꯨꯄꯥ ꯃꯁꯤꯡ ꯈꯔꯅ ꯊꯕꯛ ꯑꯃ ꯅꯨꯃꯤꯠ 60 ꯅꯤꯗ ꯂꯣꯏꯁꯤꯟꯕ ꯉꯝꯃꯤ꯫ ꯅꯨꯄꯥ 8 ꯍꯦꯟꯅ ꯌꯥꯎꯔꯕꯗꯤ, ꯊꯕꯛꯇꯨ ꯅꯨꯃꯤꯠ 10 ꯅꯤ ꯍꯟꯊꯅ ꯂꯣꯏꯁꯤꯟꯕ ꯉꯝꯒꯅꯤ꯫ ꯍꯥꯟꯅ ꯌꯥꯎꯔꯝꯕ ꯅꯨꯄꯥ ꯃꯁꯤꯡ ꯑꯗꯨ:

english_text: 68. A certain number of men can do a piece of work in 40 days. If there were 45 men more the work could have been finished in 25 days. Find the original number of men employed in the work.
bmei_text: kriguMb nupa msiZ Hrn YbK Am numiT 40 nid tOb zMmi| nupa 45 heNn yaUrMlbdi, YbKtu numiT 25 nigi mnuZd loIsiNb zMlMgdbni| YbKtud haNnn yaUrMb nupa msiZ Adu puYoKU:
mayek_text: ꯀꯔꯤꯒꯨꯝꯕ ꯅꯨꯄꯥ ꯃꯁꯤꯡ ꯈꯔꯅ ꯊꯕꯛ ꯑꯃ ꯅꯨꯃꯤꯠ 40 ꯅꯤꯗ ꯇꯧꯕ ꯉꯝꯃꯤ꯫ ꯅꯨꯄꯥ 45 ꯍꯦꯟꯅ ꯌꯥꯎꯔꯝꯂꯕꯗꯤ, ꯊꯕꯛꯇꯨ ꯅꯨꯃꯤꯠ 25 ꯅꯤꯒꯤ ꯃꯅꯨꯡꯗ ꯂꯣꯏꯁꯤꯟꯕ ꯉꯝꯂꯝꯒꯗꯕꯅꯤ꯫ ꯊꯕꯛꯇꯨꯗ ꯍꯥꯟꯅꯅ ꯌꯥꯎꯔꯝꯕ ꯅꯨꯄꯥ ꯃꯁꯤꯡ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯄꯨꯊꯣꯛꯎ:

english_text: 69. A certain number of men can do a work in 40 days. If there were 8 men more, it could be finished in 10 days less. How many men were there initially?
bmei_text: kriguMb msiZ Hrn YbK Am numiT 40 nid tOb zMmi| nupa 8 heNn yaUrbdi, YbKtu numiT 10 ni hNYn loIsiNb zMlMgni| haNn nupa kaya yaUrMbge?
mayek_text: ꯀꯔꯤꯒꯨꯝꯕ ꯃꯁꯤꯡ ꯈꯔꯅ ꯊꯕꯛ ꯑꯃ ꯅꯨꯃꯤꯠ 40 ꯅꯤꯗ ꯇꯧꯕ ꯉꯝꯃꯤ꯫ ꯅꯨꯄꯥ 8 ꯍꯦꯟꯅ ꯌꯥꯎꯔꯕꯗꯤ, ꯊꯕꯛꯇꯨ ꯅꯨꯃꯤꯠ 10 ꯅꯤ ꯍꯟꯊꯅ ꯂꯣꯏꯁꯤꯟꯕ ꯉꯝꯂꯝꯒꯅꯤ꯫ ꯍꯥꯟꯅ ꯅꯨꯄꯥ ꯀꯥꯌꯥ ꯌꯥꯎꯔꯝꯕꯒꯦ?

english_text: 70. A certain number of men can do a piece of work in 60 days. If there were 6 men more, the work can be finished 20 days earlier. The number of men working is:
bmei_text: kriguMb nupa msiZ Hrn YbK Am numiT 60 nid tOb zMmi| nupa 6 heNn yaUrbdi, YbKtu numiT 20 ni zNHTn loIsiNb zMlMgni| YbK surib nupa msiZ Adu:
mayek_text: ꯀꯔꯤꯒꯨꯝꯕ ꯅꯨꯄꯥ ꯃꯁꯤꯡ ꯈꯔꯅ ꯊꯕꯛ ꯑꯃ ꯅꯨꯃꯤꯠ 60 ꯅꯤꯗ ꯇꯧꯕ ꯉꯝꯃꯤ꯫ ꯅꯨꯄꯥ 6 ꯍꯦꯟꯅ ꯌꯥꯎꯔꯕꯗꯤ, ꯊꯕꯛꯇꯨ ꯅꯨꯃꯤꯠ 20 ꯅꯤ ꯉꯟꯈꯠꯅ ꯂꯣꯏꯁꯤꯟꯕ ꯉꯝꯂꯝꯒꯅꯤ꯫ ꯊꯕꯛ ꯁꯨꯔꯤꯕ ꯅꯨꯄꯥ ꯃꯁꯤꯡ ꯑꯗꯨ:

english_text: 71. A man, a woman and a boy can together complete a piece of work in 3 days. If a man alone can do it in 6 days and a boy alone in 18 days, how long will a woman alone take to complete the work?
bmei_text: nupa Am, nupi Am Amdi nupamca Amn puNn YbK Am numiT 3 nid loIsiNb zMmi nupa Amn mYNtn msi numiT 6 nid zMlb Adug nupamca Amn mYNtn nhmiT 18 nid zMlbdi, nupi Amn mYNtn YbKtu loIsiNbd kayaM kuIn cxgni?
mayek_text: ꯅꯨꯄꯥ ꯑꯃ, ꯅꯨꯄꯤ ꯑꯃ ꯑꯃꯗꯤ ꯅꯨꯄꯥꯃꯆꯥ ꯑꯃꯅ ꯄꯨꯟꯅ ꯊꯕꯛ ꯑꯃ ꯅꯨꯃꯤꯠ 3 ꯅꯤꯗ ꯂꯣꯏꯁꯤꯟꯕ ꯉꯝꯃꯤ ꯅꯨꯄꯥ ꯑꯃꯅ ꯃꯊꯟꯇꯅ ꯃꯁꯤ ꯅꯨꯃꯤꯠ 6 ꯅꯤꯗ ꯉꯝꯂꯕ ꯑꯗꯨꯒ ꯅꯨꯄꯥꯃꯆꯥ ꯑꯃꯅ ꯃꯊꯟꯇꯅ ꯅꯍꯃꯤꯠ 18 ꯅꯤꯗ ꯉꯝꯂꯕꯗꯤ, ꯅꯨꯄꯤ ꯑꯃꯅ ꯃꯊꯟꯇꯅ ꯊꯕꯛꯇꯨ ꯂꯣꯏꯁꯤꯟꯕꯗ ꯀꯥꯌꯥꯝ ꯀꯨꯏꯅ ꯆꯪꯒꯅꯤ?

english_text: 72. A man, a woman and a boy together finish a piece of work in 6 days. If a man and a woman can do the work in 10 and 24 days respectively, the days taken by a boy to finish the work is:
bmei_text: nupa Am, nupi Am Amdi nupamca Amn YbK Am numiT 6 nid loIsiNb zMmi| kriguMb nupa Am AmsuZ nupi Amn YbK Adu mYx-siTn numiT 10 Amdi 24 nid tOb zMlbdi, nupamcadun YbKtubu loIsiNbd cxgdb numiT msiZ Adu:
mayek_text: ꯅꯨꯄꯥ ꯑꯃ, ꯅꯨꯄꯤ ꯑꯃ ꯑꯃꯗꯤ ꯅꯨꯄꯥꯃꯆꯥ ꯑꯃꯅ ꯊꯕꯛ ꯑꯃ ꯅꯨꯃꯤꯠ 6 ꯅꯤꯗ ꯂꯣꯏꯁꯤꯟꯕ ꯉꯝꯃꯤ꯫ ꯀꯔꯤꯒꯨꯝꯕ ꯅꯨꯄꯥ ꯑꯃ ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯅꯨꯄꯤ ꯑꯃꯅ ꯊꯕꯛ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯃꯊꯪ-ꯁꯤꯠꯅ ꯅꯨꯃꯤꯠ 10 ꯑꯃꯗꯤ 24 ꯅꯤꯗ ꯇꯧꯕ ꯉꯝꯂꯕꯗꯤ, ꯅꯨꯄꯥꯃꯆꯥꯗꯨꯅ ꯊꯕꯛꯇꯨꯕꯨ ꯂꯣꯏꯁꯤꯟꯕꯗ ꯆꯪꯒꯗꯕ ꯅꯨꯃꯤꯠ ꯃꯁꯤꯡ ꯑꯗꯨ:

english_text: 73. A can do a work in 15 days and B in 20 days. If they together work on it for 4 days, then the fraction of the work that is Ieft, is:
bmei_text: A n YbK Am numiT 15 nid tOb zMmi Adug B n numiT 20 nid tOb zMmi| kriguMb mHoIn YbK Adu numiT 4 ni surbdi, leMhOrib YbK mceT Adu:
mayek_text: ꯑ ꯅ ꯊꯕꯛ ꯑꯃ ꯅꯨꯃꯤꯠ 15 ꯅꯤꯗ ꯇꯧꯕ ꯉꯝꯃꯤ ꯑꯗꯨꯒ B ꯅ ꯅꯨꯃꯤꯠ 20 ꯅꯤꯗ ꯇꯧꯕ ꯉꯝꯃꯤ꯫ ꯀꯔꯤꯒꯨꯝꯕ ꯃꯈꯣꯏꯅ ꯊꯕꯛ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯅꯨꯃꯤꯠ 4 ꯅꯤ ꯁꯨꯔꯕꯗꯤ, ꯂꯦꯝꯍꯧꯔꯤꯕ ꯊꯕꯛ ꯃꯆꯦꯠ ꯑꯗꯨ:

english_text: 74. A can finish a work in 18 days and B can do the same work in half the time taken by A. Then working together what part of the same work they can finish in a day?
bmei_text: A n YbK Am numiT 18 nid loIsiNb zMmi Adug B n YbK Adu A n cxb mtMdugi txHaigi mnuzd tOb zmMi| puNn sumiNndun, noZmd mHoIn YbK mceT kayaM loIsiNb zMgni?
mayek_text: ꯑ ꯅ ꯊꯕꯛ ꯑꯃ ꯅꯨꯃꯤꯠ 18 ꯅꯤꯗ ꯂꯣꯏꯁꯤꯟꯕ ꯉꯝꯃꯤ ꯑꯗꯨꯒ B ꯅ ꯊꯕꯛ ꯑꯗꯨ ꯑ ꯅ ꯆꯪꯕ ꯃꯇꯝꯗꯨꯒꯤ ꯇꯪꯈꯥꯤꯒꯤ ꯃꯅꯨꯉꯗ ꯇꯧꯕ ꯉꯃꯝꯤ꯫ ꯄꯨꯟꯅ ꯁꯨꯃꯤꯟꯅꯗꯨꯅ, ꯅꯣꯡꯃꯗ ꯃꯈꯣꯏꯅ ꯊꯕꯛ ꯃꯆꯦꯠ ꯀꯥꯌꯥꯝ ꯂꯣꯏꯁꯤꯟꯕ ꯉꯝꯒꯅꯤ?

english_text: 75. A can complete a work in 6 days while B can complete the same work in 12 days. If they work together and complete it, the portion of the work done by A is
bmei_text: A n YbK Am numiT 6 nid loIsiNb zMmi B n numiT 12 nid loIsiNb zMb kaNd kriguMb mHoIn YbKtu puNn sumiNnrbdi Adug loIsiLlbdi, A n tOHib YbK sruK Adu:
mayek_text: ꯑ ꯅ ꯊꯕꯛ ꯑꯃ ꯅꯨꯃꯤꯠ 6 ꯅꯤꯗ ꯂꯣꯏꯁꯤꯟꯕ ꯉꯝꯃꯤ B ꯅ ꯅꯨꯃꯤꯠ 12 ꯅꯤꯗ ꯂꯣꯏꯁꯤꯟꯕ ꯉꯝꯕ ꯀꯥꯟꯗ ꯀꯔꯤꯒꯨꯝꯕ ꯃꯈꯣꯏꯅ ꯊꯕꯛꯇꯨ ꯄꯨꯟꯅ ꯁꯨꯃꯤꯟꯅꯔꯕꯗꯤ ꯑꯗꯨꯒ ꯂꯣꯏꯁꯤꯜꯂꯕꯗꯤ, ꯑ ꯅ ꯇꯧꯈꯤꯕ ꯊꯕꯛ ꯁꯔꯨꯛ ꯑꯗꯨ:

english_text: 76. A and B can do a piece of work in 72 days, B and C can do it in 120 days, and A and C can do it in 90 days. When A, B and C work together, how much work is finished by them in 3 days?
bmei_text: A g B gn YbK Am numiT 72 nid tOb zMmi, B g C gn numiT 120 nid Adug A g C gn numiT 90 nid tOb zMmi| A, B AmsuZ C puNn sumiNnbd, numiT 3 nid mHoIn YbK kayaM loIsiNbge?
mayek_text: ꯑ ꯒ B ꯒꯅ ꯊꯕꯛ ꯑꯃ ꯅꯨꯃꯤꯠ 72 ꯅꯤꯗ ꯇꯧꯕ ꯉꯝꯃꯤ, B ꯒ C ꯒꯅ ꯅꯨꯃꯤꯠ 120 ꯅꯤꯗ ꯑꯗꯨꯒ ꯑ ꯒ C ꯒꯅ ꯅꯨꯃꯤꯠ 90 ꯅꯤꯗ ꯇꯧꯕ ꯉꯝꯃꯤ꯫ ꯑ, B ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ C ꯄꯨꯟꯅ ꯁꯨꯃꯤꯟꯅꯕꯗ, ꯅꯨꯃꯤꯠ 3 ꯅꯤꯗ ꯃꯈꯣꯏꯅ ꯊꯕꯛ ꯀꯥꯌꯥꯝ ꯂꯣꯏꯁꯤꯟꯕꯒꯦ?

english_text: 77. A alone can do a piece of work in 20 days and B alone in 30 days. They begin to work together. They will finish half of the work in:
bmei_text: A mYNtn YbK Am numiT 20 nid tOb zMmi AmsuZ B n numiTN 30 nid| mHoIn puNn YbKtu sub hOmiNnre| mHoIn YbKtu txHaI Am numiT kayanid loIsiNgni?
mayek_text: ꯑ ꯃꯊꯟꯇꯅ ꯊꯕꯛ ꯑꯃ ꯅꯨꯃꯤꯠ 20 ꯅꯤꯗ ꯇꯧꯕ ꯉꯝꯃꯤ ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ B ꯅ ꯅꯨꯃꯤꯠꯟ 30 ꯅꯤꯗ꯫ ꯃꯈꯣꯏꯅ ꯄꯨꯟꯅ ꯊꯕꯛꯇꯨ ꯁꯨꯕ ꯍꯧꯃꯤꯟꯅꯔꯦ꯫ ꯃꯈꯣꯏꯅ ꯊꯕꯛꯇꯨ ꯇꯪꯈꯥꯏ ꯑꯃ ꯅꯨꯃꯤꯠ ꯀꯥꯌꯥꯅꯤꯗ ꯂꯣꯏꯁꯤꯟꯒꯅꯤ?

english_text: 78. A can do a work in 10 days and B in 20 days. If they together work on it for 5 days, then the fraction of the work that is left is
bmei_text: A n numiT 10 nid YbK Am tOb zMmi Adug B n numiT 20 nid tOb zMmi| kriguMb mHoIn numiT 5 ni puNn suMiNnrbdi, leMhOgdb YbK AceT Adu:
mayek_text: ꯑ ꯅ ꯅꯨꯃꯤꯠ 10 ꯅꯤꯗ ꯊꯕꯛ ꯑꯃ ꯇꯧꯕ ꯉꯝꯃꯤ ꯑꯗꯨꯒ B ꯅ ꯅꯨꯃꯤꯠ 20 ꯅꯤꯗ ꯇꯧꯕ ꯉꯝꯃꯤ꯫ ꯀꯔꯤꯒꯨꯝꯕ ꯃꯈꯣꯏꯅ ꯅꯨꯃꯤꯠ 5 ꯅꯤ ꯄꯨꯟꯅ ꯁꯨꯝꯤꯟꯅꯔꯕꯗꯤ, ꯂꯦꯝꯍꯧꯒꯗꯕ ꯊꯕꯛ ꯑꯆꯦꯠ ꯑꯗꯨ:

english_text: 79. If 12 men working 8 hours a day complete the work in 10 days, how long would 16 men working  hours a day take to complete the same work?
bmei_text: nupa 12 n noZmd puZ 8 surg YbK Am numiT 10 nid loIsiNb zMlbdi, nupa 16 n noZmd puZ  surg YbKtu loIsiNbd kayaM kuIn cxgni?
mayek_text: ꯅꯨꯄꯥ 12 ꯅ ꯅꯣꯡꯃꯗ ꯄꯨꯡ 8 ꯁꯨꯔꯒ ꯊꯕꯛ ꯑꯃ ꯅꯨꯃꯤꯠ 10 ꯅꯤꯗ ꯂꯣꯏꯁꯤꯟꯕ ꯉꯝꯂꯕꯗꯤ, ꯅꯨꯄꯥ 16 ꯅ ꯅꯣꯡꯃꯗ ꯄꯨꯡ  ꯁꯨꯔꯒ ꯊꯕꯛꯇꯨ ꯂꯣꯏꯁꯤꯟꯕꯗ ꯀꯥꯌꯥꯝ ꯀꯨꯏꯅ ꯆꯪꯒꯅꯤ?

english_text: 80. 39 persons can repair a road in 12 days working 5 hours a day. In how many days will 30 persons working 6 hours a day complete the work?
bmei_text: miAoI 39 n lMbi Am numiT 12 nid noZmd puZ 5 surg seMjiNb zMmi| numiT kayanid miAoI 30 n noZmd puz 6 surg YbKtu loIsiNb zMgni?
mayek_text: ꯃꯤꯑꯣꯏ 39 ꯅ ꯂꯝꯕꯤ ꯑꯃ ꯅꯨꯃꯤꯠ 12 ꯅꯤꯗ ꯅꯣꯡꯃꯗ ꯄꯨꯡ 5 ꯁꯨꯔꯒ ꯁꯦꯝꯖꯤꯟꯕ ꯉꯝꯃꯤ꯫ ꯅꯨꯃꯤꯠ ꯀꯥꯌꯥꯅꯤꯗ ꯃꯤꯑꯣꯏ 30 ꯅ ꯅꯣꯡꯃꯗ ꯄꯨꯉ 6 ꯁꯨꯔꯒ ꯊꯕꯛꯇꯨ ꯂꯣꯏꯁꯤꯟꯕ ꯉꯝꯒꯅꯤ?

english_text: 81. If 72 men can build a wall of 280 m length in 21 days, how many men could take 18 days to build a similar type of wall of length 100 m?
bmei_text: nupa 72 n mitr 280 sazb fKlaZ Am numiT 21 nid sab zMlbdi, mitr 100 saZb cP maNnb fKlaZ Am numiT 18 nid nupa kayan sab zMgni?
mayek_text: ꯅꯨꯄꯥ 72 ꯅ ꯃꯤꯇꯔ 280 ꯁꯥꯉꯕ ꯐꯛꯂꯥꯡ ꯑꯃ ꯅꯨꯃꯤꯠ 21 ꯅꯤꯗ ꯁꯥꯕ ꯉꯝꯂꯕꯗꯤ, ꯃꯤꯇꯔ 100 ꯁꯥꯡꯕ ꯆꯞ ꯃꯥꯟꯅꯕ ꯐꯛꯂꯥꯡ ꯑꯃ ꯅꯨꯃꯤꯠ 18 ꯅꯤꯗ ꯅꯨꯄꯥ ꯀꯥꯌꯥꯅ ꯁꯥꯕ ꯉꯝꯒꯅꯤ?

english_text: 82. 4 mat-weavers can weave 4 mats in 4 days. At the same rate how many mats would be woven by 8 mat-weavers in 8 days?
bmei_text: fK loNbi mribn fK mri numiT mrinigi mnuZd loNb zMmi| Adugi caZd fK loNbi 8 n numiT 8 nid fK kaya loNgni?
mayek_text: ꯐꯛ ꯂꯣꯟꯕꯤ ꯃꯔꯤꯕꯅ ꯐꯛ ꯃꯔꯤ ꯅꯨꯃꯤꯠ ꯃꯔꯤꯅꯤꯒꯤ ꯃꯅꯨꯡꯗ ꯂꯣꯟꯕ ꯉꯝꯃꯤ꯫ ꯑꯗꯨꯒꯤ ꯆꯥꯡꯗ ꯐꯛ ꯂꯣꯟꯕꯤ 8 ꯅ ꯅꯨꯃꯤꯠ 8 ꯅꯤꯗ ꯐꯛ ꯀꯥꯌꯥ ꯂꯣꯟꯒꯅꯤ?

english_text: 83. 10 men working 6 hours a day can complete a work in 18 days. How many hours a day must 15 men work to complete the same work in 12 days?
bmei_text: nupa 10 n noZmd puZ 6 surg YbK Am numiT 18 nid loIsiNb zMmi| YbK tubu numiT 12 nid nupa 15 n loIsiNnb noZmd puZ kaya YbK sugni?
mayek_text: ꯅꯨꯄꯥ 10 ꯅ ꯅꯣꯡꯃꯗ ꯄꯨꯡ 6 ꯁꯨꯔꯒ ꯊꯕꯛ ꯑꯃ ꯅꯨꯃꯤꯠ 18 ꯅꯤꯗ ꯂꯣꯏꯁꯤꯟꯕ ꯉꯝꯃꯤ꯫ ꯊꯕꯛ ꯇꯨꯕꯨ ꯅꯨꯃꯤꯠ 12 ꯅꯤꯗ ꯅꯨꯄꯥ 15 ꯅ ꯂꯣꯏꯁꯤꯟꯅꯕ ꯅꯣꯡꯃꯗ ꯄꯨꯡ ꯀꯥꯌꯥ ꯊꯕꯛ ꯁꯨꯒꯅꯤ?

english_text: 84. Two persons can complete a piece of work in 9 days. How many more persons are needed to complete double the work in 12 days?
bmei_text: miAoI Anin YbK Am numiT 9 nid loIsiNb zMmi| YbKtuguMb sruK Ani caUb YbK Am numiT 12 nid loIsinbd AheNb nupa kaya drkar AoIgni?
mayek_text: ꯃꯤꯑꯣꯏ ꯑꯅꯤꯅ ꯊꯕꯛ ꯑꯃ ꯅꯨꯃꯤꯠ 9 ꯅꯤꯗ ꯂꯣꯏꯁꯤꯟꯕ ꯉꯝꯃꯤ꯫ ꯊꯕꯛꯇꯨꯒꯨꯝꯕ ꯁꯔꯨꯛ ꯑꯅꯤ ꯆꯥꯎꯕ ꯊꯕꯛ ꯑꯃ ꯅꯨꯃꯤꯠ 12 ꯅꯤꯗ ꯂꯣꯏꯁꯤꯅꯕꯗ ꯑꯍꯦꯟꯕ ꯅꯨꯄꯥ ꯀꯥꯌꯥ ꯗꯔꯀꯥꯔ ꯑꯣꯏꯒꯅꯤ?

english_text: 85. If 10 men can do a piece of work in 12 days, the time taken by 12 men to do the same piece of work will be
bmei_text: nupa 10 n YbK Am numiT 12 nid tOb zMlbdi, nupa 12 n YbK AdumK tObd cxgdb mtM Adu:
mayek_text: ꯅꯨꯄꯥ 10 ꯅ ꯊꯕꯛ ꯑꯃ ꯅꯨꯃꯤꯠ 12 ꯅꯤꯗ ꯇꯧꯕ ꯉꯝꯂꯕꯗꯤ, ꯅꯨꯄꯥ 12 ꯅ ꯊꯕꯛ ꯑꯗꯨꯃꯛ ꯇꯧꯕꯗ ꯆꯪꯒꯗꯕ ꯃꯇꯝ ꯑꯗꯨ:

english_text: 86. 7 men can complete a piece of work in 12 days. How many additional men will be required to complete double the work in 8 days?
bmei_text: nupa 7 n YbK Am numiT 12 nid loIsiNb zMmi| YbKtu numiT 8 nid loIsiNnb AheNb nupa kaya drkar AoIgni?
mayek_text: ꯅꯨꯄꯥ 7 ꯅ ꯊꯕꯛ ꯑꯃ ꯅꯨꯃꯤꯠ 12 ꯅꯤꯗ ꯂꯣꯏꯁꯤꯟꯕ ꯉꯝꯃꯤ꯫ ꯊꯕꯛꯇꯨ ꯅꯨꯃꯤꯠ 8 ꯅꯤꯗ ꯂꯣꯏꯁꯤꯟꯅꯕ ꯑꯍꯦꯟꯕ ꯅꯨꯄꯥ ꯀꯥꯌꯥ ꯗꯔꯀꯥꯔ ꯑꯣꯏꯒꯅꯤ?

english_text: 87. Working 8 hours a day, Anu can copy a book in 18 days. How many hours a day should she work so as to finish the work in 12 days?
bmei_text: noZmd puZ 8 surg Anun laIriK Am numiT 18 nid siNb zMmi| YbKtu numiT 12 nid loIsiNnb mhaKn noZmd puZ kaya sugdbno?
mayek_text: ꯅꯣꯡꯃꯗ ꯄꯨꯡ 8 ꯁꯨꯔꯒ ꯑꯅꯨꯅ ꯂꯥꯏꯔꯤꯛ ꯑꯃ ꯅꯨꯃꯤꯠ 18 ꯅꯤꯗ ꯁꯤꯟꯕ ꯉꯝꯃꯤ꯫ ꯊꯕꯛꯇꯨ ꯅꯨꯃꯤꯠ 12 ꯅꯤꯗ ꯂꯣꯏꯁꯤꯟꯅꯕ ꯃꯍꯥꯛꯅ ꯅꯣꯡꯃꯗ ꯄꯨꯡ ꯀꯥꯌꯥ ꯁꯨꯒꯗꯕꯅꯣ?

english_text: 88. If 80 persons can finish a work within 16 days by working 6 hours a day, the number of hours a day, should 64 persons work to finish that very job within 15 days is:
bmei_text: noZmd puZ 6 surg miaAoI 80 n YbK Am numiT 16 gi mnuZd loIsiNb zMlbdi, miAoI 64 n YbKtumK numiT 15 nigi mnuZd loIsiNnb noZmd puZ kaya YbK sugdbno?
mayek_text: ꯅꯣꯡꯃꯗ ꯄꯨꯡ 6 ꯁꯨꯔꯒ ꯃꯤꯥꯑꯣꯏ 80 ꯅ ꯊꯕꯛ ꯑꯃ ꯅꯨꯃꯤꯠ 16 ꯒꯤ ꯃꯅꯨꯡꯗ ꯂꯣꯏꯁꯤꯟꯕ ꯉꯝꯂꯕꯗꯤ, ꯃꯤꯑꯣꯏ 64 ꯅ ꯊꯕꯛꯇꯨꯃꯛ ꯅꯨꯃꯤꯠ 15 ꯅꯤꯒꯤ ꯃꯅꯨꯡꯗ ꯂꯣꯏꯁꯤꯟꯅꯕ ꯅꯣꯡꯃꯗ ꯄꯨꯡ ꯀꯥꯌꯥ ꯊꯕꯛ ꯁꯨꯒꯗꯕꯅꯣ?

english_text: 89. 18 boys can do a piece of work in 24 days. In how many days can 27 boys do the same?
bmei_text: nupa mca 18 n YbK Am numiT 24 nid tOb zMmi| numiT kayanid nupamca 27 n YbKtu tOb zMgni?
mayek_text: ꯅꯨꯄꯥ ꯃꯆꯥ 18 ꯅ ꯊꯕꯛ ꯑꯃ ꯅꯨꯃꯤꯠ 24 ꯅꯤꯗ ꯇꯧꯕ ꯉꯝꯃꯤ꯫ ꯅꯨꯃꯤꯠ ꯀꯥꯌꯥꯅꯤꯗ ꯅꯨꯄꯥꯃꯆꯥ 27 ꯅ ꯊꯕꯛꯇꯨ ꯇꯧꯕ ꯉꯝꯒꯅꯤ?

english_text: 90. If x men can do a piece of work in x days, then the number of days in which y men can do the same work is:
bmei_text: nupa x n YbK Am numiT x nigi mnuZd tOb zMlbdi, nupa y ndi YbKtubu numiT kayanid tOb zMgni?
mayek_text: ꯅꯨꯄꯥ x ꯅ ꯊꯕꯛ ꯑꯃ ꯅꯨꯃꯤꯠ x ꯅꯤꯒꯤ ꯃꯅꯨꯡꯗ ꯇꯧꯕ ꯉꯝꯂꯕꯗꯤ, ꯅꯨꯄꯥ ꯌ ꯅꯗꯤ ꯊꯕꯛꯇꯨꯕꯨ ꯅꯨꯃꯤꯠ ꯀꯥꯌꯥꯅꯤꯗ ꯇꯧꯕ ꯉꯝꯒꯅꯤ?

english_text: 91. 24 men can do a piece of work in 17 days. How many men will be able to do it in 51 days?
bmei_text: nupa 24 n YbK aAm numiT 17 nid tOb zMmi| YbKtu numiT 51 nid nupa kayan tOb zMgni?
mayek_text: ꯅꯨꯄꯥ 24 ꯅ ꯊꯕꯛ ꯑꯑꯃ ꯅꯨꯃꯤꯠ 17 ꯅꯤꯗ ꯇꯧꯕ ꯉꯝꯃꯤ꯫ ꯊꯕꯛꯇꯨ ꯅꯨꯃꯤꯠ 51 ꯅꯤꯗ ꯅꯨꯄꯥ ꯀꯥꯌꯥꯅ ꯇꯧꯕ ꯉꯝꯒꯅꯤ?

english_text: 92. If 7 spiders make 7 webs in 7 days, then 1 spider will make 1 web in how many days?
bmei_text: mi 7 n miraZ 7 numiT 7 nid sab zMlbdi, mi Amndi miraZ Am numiT kayanid sab zMgni?
mayek_text: ꯃꯤ 7 ꯅ ꯃꯤꯔꯥꯡ 7 ꯅꯨꯃꯤꯠ 7 ꯅꯤꯗ ꯁꯥꯕ ꯉꯝꯂꯕꯗꯤ, ꯃꯤ ꯑꯃꯅꯗꯤ ꯃꯤꯔꯥꯡ ꯑꯃ ꯅꯨꯃꯤꯠ ꯀꯥꯌꯥꯅꯤꯗ ꯁꯥꯕ ꯉꯝꯒꯅꯤ?

english_text: 93. X and Y together can do a piece of work in 8 days, which X alone can do in 12 days. In how many days can Y do the same work alone?
bmei_text: X k Y gn puNn YbK Am numiT 8 nid tOb zMmi, X mYNtn numiT 12 nid tOb zMb YbK Adu| numiT kayanid Y mYNtn YbK AdumK tOb zMgni?
mayek_text: X ꯀ ꯊ ꯒꯅ ꯄꯨꯟꯅ ꯊꯕꯛ ꯑꯃ ꯅꯨꯃꯤꯠ 8 ꯅꯤꯗ ꯇꯧꯕ ꯉꯝꯃꯤ, X ꯃꯊꯟꯇꯅ ꯅꯨꯃꯤꯠ 12 ꯅꯤꯗ ꯇꯧꯕ ꯉꯝꯕ ꯊꯕꯛ ꯑꯗꯨ꯫ ꯅꯨꯃꯤꯠ ꯀꯥꯌꯥꯅꯤꯗ ꯊ ꯃꯊꯟꯇꯅ ꯊꯕꯛ ꯑꯗꯨꯃꯛ ꯇꯧꯕ ꯉꯝꯒꯅꯤ?

english_text: 94. Three persons A, B and C can do a job alone in 10 days, 12 days and 15 days respectively. In how many days they can finish the job working together?
bmei_text: miAoI AhuM A, B Amdi C n YbK Am mYN-mYNtn mYx-siTn numiT 10 ni, 12 ni Amdi 15 nid tOb zMmi| numiT kayanid mHoIn puNn YbKtubu loIsiNb zMgni?
mayek_text: ꯃꯤꯑꯣꯏ ꯑꯍꯨꯝ ꯑ, B ꯑꯃꯗꯤ C ꯅ ꯊꯕꯛ ꯑꯃ ꯃꯊꯟ-ꯃꯊꯟꯇꯅ ꯃꯊꯪ-ꯁꯤꯠꯅ ꯅꯨꯃꯤꯠ 10 ꯅꯤ, 12 ꯅꯤ ꯑꯃꯗꯤ 15 ꯅꯤꯗ ꯇꯧꯕ ꯉꯝꯃꯤ꯫ ꯅꯨꯃꯤꯠ ꯀꯥꯌꯥꯅꯤꯗ ꯃꯈꯣꯏꯅ ꯄꯨꯟꯅ ꯊꯕꯛꯇꯨꯕꯨ ꯂꯣꯏꯁꯤꯟꯕ ꯉꯝꯒꯅꯤ?

english_text: 95. Two persons A and B can do a piece of work alone in 10 days and 15 days respectively. If A works for 2 days and B works for 5 days, find the total amount of work done.
bmei_text: miAoI Ani A g B g YbK Am mYN-mYNtn nYx-siTn numiT 10 ni Amdi 15 nid tOb zMmi| A numiT 2 surbdi Adug B n numiT 5 ni surbdi, tOHib YbKtu puNn puYoKU:
mayek_text: ꯃꯤꯑꯣꯏ ꯑꯅꯤ ꯑ ꯒ B ꯒ ꯊꯕꯛ ꯑꯃ ꯃꯊꯟ-ꯃꯊꯟꯇꯅ ꯅꯊꯪ-ꯁꯤꯠꯅ ꯅꯨꯃꯤꯠ 10 ꯅꯤ ꯑꯃꯗꯤ 15 ꯅꯤꯗ ꯇꯧꯕ ꯉꯝꯃꯤ꯫ ꯑ ꯅꯨꯃꯤꯠ 2 ꯁꯨꯔꯕꯗꯤ ꯑꯗꯨꯒ B ꯅ ꯅꯨꯃꯤꯠ 5 ꯅꯤ ꯁꯨꯔꯕꯗꯤ, ꯇꯧꯈꯤꯕ ꯊꯕꯛꯇꯨ ꯄꯨꯟꯅ ꯄꯨꯊꯣꯛꯎ:

english_text: 96. Amit can do piece of work in 4 days and Sumit can do it in 6 days. How long will they take, if both Amit and Sumit work together?
bmei_text: AmiTn YbK Am numiT 4 nid tOb zMmi Adug sumiTn numiT 6 nid tOb zMmi| mHoIn puNn sumiNnrbdi, kayaM kuIn cxgni?
mayek_text: ꯑꯃꯤꯠꯅ ꯊꯕꯛ ꯑꯃ ꯅꯨꯃꯤꯠ 4 ꯅꯤꯗ ꯇꯧꯕ ꯉꯝꯃꯤ ꯑꯗꯨꯒ ꯁꯨꯃꯤꯠꯅ ꯅꯨꯃꯤꯠ 6 ꯅꯤꯗ ꯇꯧꯕ ꯉꯝꯃꯤ꯫ ꯃꯈꯣꯏꯅ ꯄꯨꯟꯅ ꯁꯨꯃꯤꯟꯅꯔꯕꯗꯤ, ꯀꯥꯌꯥꯝ ꯀꯨꯏꯅ ꯆꯪꯒꯅꯤ?

english_text: 97. Together, Chotu and Nitu plough a field in 4 days. Nitu alone takes 6 days to plough the same field. In how many days can Chotu alone plough the field?
bmei_text: puNn sotu g nitugn lObuK Am numiT 4 nid HoIb zMmi| nitu mYNtn cP maNnb lObuKtu HoIbd numiT 6 ni cxI| numiT kayanigi mnuZd sotun mYNtn lObuKtubu HoIb zMgni?
mayek_text: ꯄꯨꯟꯅ ꯁꯣꯇꯨ ꯒ ꯅꯤꯇꯨꯒꯅ ꯂꯧꯕꯨꯛ ꯑꯃ ꯅꯨꯃꯤꯠ 4 ꯅꯤꯗ ꯈꯣꯏꯕ ꯉꯝꯃꯤ꯫ ꯅꯤꯇꯨ ꯃꯊꯟꯇꯅ ꯆꯞ ꯃꯥꯟꯅꯕ ꯂꯧꯕꯨꯛꯇꯨ ꯈꯣꯏꯕꯗ ꯅꯨꯃꯤꯠ 6 ꯅꯤ ꯆꯪꯏ꯫ ꯅꯨꯃꯤꯠ ꯀꯥꯌꯥꯅꯤꯒꯤ ꯃꯅꯨꯡꯗ ꯁꯣꯇꯨꯅ ꯃꯊꯟꯇꯅ ꯂꯧꯕꯨꯛꯇꯨꯕꯨ ꯈꯣꯏꯕ ꯉꯝꯒꯅꯤ?

english_text: 98. Kami, Karya and Kirti can together weave a carpet in 4 days. Kami by herself can weave the same sized carpet in 12 days and Kirti can do it in 10 days. How long will Karya take to do the work by herself?
bmei_text: kami, kary_a Amdi kirtin puNn karpeT Am numiT 4 nid tub zMmi| kamin msa mYNtn caUb cP maNnb karpeT Am numiT 12 nid tub zMmi Adug kritin numiT 10 nid zMmi| kary_an mYNtn tObd numiT kayani cxgni?
mayek_text: ꯀꯥꯃꯤ, ꯀꯥꯔ꯭ꯌꯥ ꯑꯃꯗꯤ ꯀꯤꯔꯇꯤꯅ ꯄꯨꯟꯅ ꯀꯥꯔꯄꯦꯠ ꯑꯃ ꯅꯨꯃꯤꯠ 4 ꯅꯤꯗ ꯇꯨꯕ ꯉꯝꯃꯤ꯫ ꯀꯥꯃꯤꯅ ꯃꯁꯥ ꯃꯊꯟꯇꯅ ꯆꯥꯎꯕ ꯆꯞ ꯃꯥꯟꯅꯕ ꯀꯥꯔꯄꯦꯠ ꯑꯃ ꯅꯨꯃꯤꯠ 12 ꯅꯤꯗ ꯇꯨꯕ ꯉꯝꯃꯤ ꯑꯗꯨꯒ ꯀꯔꯤꯇꯤꯅ ꯅꯨꯃꯤꯠ 10 ꯅꯤꯗ ꯉꯝꯃꯤ꯫ ꯀꯥꯔ꯭ꯌꯥꯅ ꯃꯊꯟꯇꯅ ꯇꯧꯕꯗ ꯅꯨꯃꯤꯠ ꯀꯥꯌꯥꯅꯤ ꯆꯪꯒꯅꯤ?

english_text: 99. If 20 men take 30 days to complete a job, in many days can 25 men complete the job?
bmei_text: YbK Am nupa 20 n loIsiNbd numiT 30 ni cxlbdi, nupa 25 n YbKtu loIsiNbd numiT kayani cxgni?
mayek_text: ꯊꯕꯛ ꯑꯃ ꯅꯨꯄꯥ 20 ꯅ ꯂꯣꯏꯁꯤꯟꯕꯗ ꯅꯨꯃꯤꯠ 30 ꯅꯤ ꯆꯪꯂꯕꯗꯤ, ꯅꯨꯄꯥ 25 ꯅ ꯊꯕꯛꯇꯨ ꯂꯣꯏꯁꯤꯟꯕꯗ ꯅꯨꯃꯤꯠ ꯀꯥꯌꯥꯅꯤ ꯆꯪꯒꯅꯤ?

english_text: 100. Fifteen men take 10 days to complete a job working 12 hours a day. How many hours a day should 10 men work to complete the job in 20 days?
bmei_text: nupa 15 n noZmd puz 12 surg ybK Am loIsiNbd numiT 10 ni cxI| YbKtubu numiT 20 nid nupa 10 n loIsiNnb noZmd puZ kaya sugdbno?
mayek_text: ꯅꯨꯄꯥ 15 ꯅ ꯅꯣꯡꯃꯗ ꯄꯨꯉ 12 ꯁꯨꯔꯒ ꯌꯕꯛ ꯑꯃ ꯂꯣꯏꯁꯤꯟꯕꯗ ꯅꯨꯃꯤꯠ 10 ꯅꯤ ꯆꯪꯏ꯫ ꯊꯕꯛꯇꯨꯕꯨ ꯅꯨꯃꯤꯠ 20 ꯅꯤꯗ ꯅꯨꯄꯥ 10 ꯅ ꯂꯣꯏꯁꯤꯟꯅꯕ ꯅꯣꯡꯃꯗ ꯄꯨꯡ ꯀꯥꯌꯥ ꯁꯨꯒꯗꯕꯅꯣ?

english_text: 101. A piece of work can be done by 16 men in 8 days working 12 hours a day. How many men are needed to complete another work, which is three times the first one, in 24 days working 8 hours a day?
bmei_text: nupa 16 n YbK Am noZmd puZ 12 surg numiT 8 nid tOb zMmi| YbKtuguMb sruK AhuMmuK caUb AtoPp YbK Am loIsiNbd nupa kaya drkar AoIgni, noZmd puZ 8 surg numiT 24 nigi mnuZd?
mayek_text: ꯅꯨꯄꯥ 16 ꯅ ꯊꯕꯛ ꯑꯃ ꯅꯣꯡꯃꯗ ꯄꯨꯡ 12 ꯁꯨꯔꯒ ꯅꯨꯃꯤꯠ 8 ꯅꯤꯗ ꯇꯧꯕ ꯉꯝꯃꯤ꯫ ꯊꯕꯛꯇꯨꯒꯨꯝꯕ ꯁꯔꯨꯛ ꯑꯍꯨꯝꯃꯨꯛ ꯆꯥꯎꯕ ꯑꯇꯣꯞꯄ ꯊꯕꯛ ꯑꯃ ꯂꯣꯏꯁꯤꯟꯕꯗ ꯅꯨꯄꯥ ꯀꯥꯌꯥ ꯗꯔꯀꯥꯔ ꯑꯣꯏꯒꯅꯤ, ꯅꯣꯡꯃꯗ ꯄꯨꯡ 8 ꯁꯨꯔꯒ ꯅꯨꯃꯤꯠ 24 ꯅꯤꯒꯤ ꯃꯅꯨꯡꯗ?

english_text: 102. A can do a piece of work in 9 days, B can do the same in 12 days. In how many days can the work be completed if A and B work together?
bmei_text: A n YbK Am numiT 9 nid tOb zMmi, B n numiT 12 nid YbK AdumK tOb zMmi| A g B g puNn tOmiNrbdi, YbKtu numiT kayanid loIsiNb zMgni?
mayek_text: ꯑ ꯅ ꯊꯕꯛ ꯑꯃ ꯅꯨꯃꯤꯠ 9 ꯅꯤꯗ ꯇꯧꯕ ꯉꯝꯃꯤ, B ꯅ ꯅꯨꯃꯤꯠ 12 ꯅꯤꯗ ꯊꯕꯛ ꯑꯗꯨꯃꯛ ꯇꯧꯕ ꯉꯝꯃꯤ꯫ ꯑ ꯒ B ꯒ ꯄꯨꯟꯅ ꯇꯧꯃꯤꯟꯔꯕꯗꯤ, ꯊꯕꯛꯇꯨ ꯅꯨꯃꯤꯠ ꯀꯥꯌꯥꯅꯤꯗ ꯂꯣꯏꯁꯤꯟꯕ ꯉꯝꯒꯅꯤ?

english_text: 103. A and B together can do a piece of work in 12 days and A alone can complete the work in 18 days. How long will B alone take to complete the job?
bmei_text: A g B gn YbK Am numiT 12 nid tOb zMmi Adug A mYNtn numiT 18 nid tOb zMmi| B mYNtn YbKtu loIsiNbd kayaM kuIn cxgni?
mayek_text: ꯑ ꯒ B ꯒꯅ ꯊꯕꯛ ꯑꯃ ꯅꯨꯃꯤꯠ 12 ꯅꯤꯗ ꯇꯧꯕ ꯉꯝꯃꯤ ꯑꯗꯨꯒ ꯑ ꯃꯊꯟꯇꯅ ꯅꯨꯃꯤꯠ 18 ꯅꯤꯗ ꯇꯧꯕ ꯉꯝꯃꯤ꯫ B ꯃꯊꯟꯇꯅ ꯊꯕꯛꯇꯨ ꯂꯣꯏꯁꯤꯟꯕꯗ ꯀꯥꯌꯥꯝ ꯀꯨꯏꯅ ꯆꯪꯒꯅꯤ?

english_text: 104. A can do a work in 15 days and B in 20 days. If they work on it together for 4 days, then the fraction of the work that is left is:
bmei_text: A n YbK Am numiT 15 nid tOb zMmi Adug B n numiT 20 nid| mHoIn puNn YbKtu numiT 4 ni tOmiNnrbdi, leMhOrib YbK mceT Adu:
mayek_text: ꯑ ꯅ ꯊꯕꯛ ꯑꯃ ꯅꯨꯃꯤꯠ 15 ꯅꯤꯗ ꯇꯧꯕ ꯉꯝꯃꯤ ꯑꯗꯨꯒ B ꯅ ꯅꯨꯃꯤꯠ 20 ꯅꯤꯗ꯫ ꯃꯈꯣꯏꯅ ꯄꯨꯟꯅ ꯊꯕꯛꯇꯨ ꯅꯨꯃꯤꯠ 4 ꯅꯤ ꯇꯧꯃꯤꯟꯅꯔꯕꯗꯤ, ꯂꯦꯝꯍꯧꯔꯤꯕ ꯊꯕꯛ ꯃꯆꯦꯠ ꯑꯗꯨ:

english_text: 105. A can lay railway track between two given stations in 16 days and B can do the same job in 12 days. With help of C, they did the job in 4 days only. Then, C alone can do the job in:
bmei_text: A n st_esN Anigi mrKt lEb reL lMbi Am numiT 16 nid Yab zMmi Adug B n mdumK numiT 12 nid zMmi AmsuZ C gi mteZ yaUrg, mHoIn YbKtu numiT 4 ni HKki mnuZd tOb zMmi| Adudi, C mYNtn YbKtu numiT kayanid tOb zMgni?
mayek_text: ꯑ ꯅ ꯁ꯭ꯇꯦꯁꯟ ꯑꯅꯤꯒꯤ ꯃꯔꯛꯇ ꯂꯩꯕ ꯔꯦꯜ ꯂꯝꯕꯤ ꯑꯃ ꯅꯨꯃꯤꯠ 16 ꯅꯤꯗ ꯊꯥꯕ ꯉꯝꯃꯤ ꯑꯗꯨꯒ B ꯅ ꯃꯗꯨꯃꯛ ꯅꯨꯃꯤꯠ 12 ꯅꯤꯗ ꯉꯝꯃꯤ ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ C ꯒꯤ ꯃꯇꯦꯡ ꯌꯥꯎꯔꯒ, ꯃꯈꯣꯏꯅ ꯊꯕꯛꯇꯨ ꯅꯨꯃꯤꯠ 4 ꯅꯤ ꯈꯛꯀꯤ ꯃꯅꯨꯡꯗ ꯇꯧꯕ ꯉꯝꯃꯤ꯫ ꯑꯗꯨꯗꯤ, C ꯃꯊꯟꯇꯅ ꯊꯕꯛꯇꯨ ꯅꯨꯃꯤꯠ ꯀꯥꯌꯥꯅꯤꯗ ꯇꯧꯕ ꯉꯝꯒꯅꯤ?

english_text: 106. A can do a piece of work in 4 hours; B and C together can do it in 3 hours, while A and C together can do it in 2 hours. How long will B alone take to do it?
bmei_text: A n YbKtu puZ 4 gi mnuZd tOb zMmi; B g C gn puNn puZ 3 gi mnuZd tOb zMmi, A g C gn puNn puz 2 ni mnuZd tOb zMb kaNd| B mYNtn YbKtu tObd kayaM kuIn cxgni?
mayek_text: ꯑ ꯅ ꯊꯕꯛꯇꯨ ꯄꯨꯡ 4 ꯒꯤ ꯃꯅꯨꯡꯗ ꯇꯧꯕ ꯉꯝꯃꯤ; B ꯒ C ꯒꯅ ꯄꯨꯟꯅ ꯄꯨꯡ 3 ꯒꯤ ꯃꯅꯨꯡꯗ ꯇꯧꯕ ꯉꯝꯃꯤ, ꯑ ꯒ C ꯒꯅ ꯄꯨꯟꯅ ꯄꯨꯉ 2 ꯅꯤ ꯃꯅꯨꯡꯗ ꯇꯧꯕ ꯉꯝꯕ ꯀꯥꯟꯗ꯫ B ꯃꯊꯟꯇꯅ ꯊꯕꯛꯇꯨ ꯇꯧꯕꯗ ꯀꯥꯌꯥꯝ ꯀꯨꯏꯅ ꯆꯪꯒꯅꯤ?
